text: Ginpakigbato sang pila mga mamalidha sa Kamara ang mga impeachment proceeding batok kay President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: Ini matapos gindeklara nga kulang sang nagakaigo nga ebidensya ang mga reklamo batok sa Presidente sang House Committee on Justice.
english: This was after the complaints against the President of the House Committee on Justice were declared lacking in proper evidence.

text: Suno kay House Committee on Justice Chairperson Representative Gerville Luistro, indi pa sini mahambal nga dalayon na nga natapos ang mga impeachment complaint batok kay Marcos bangud nga pwede pa ini nga baliskaron sa plenaryo ang report sang committee kun pagasuportahan sang one third sang myembro sang House of the Representative .

text: Samtang nagpahayag man sang pagkadismaya ang pila ka mga kongresita kaangay ni ACT Teachers party-list Representative Antonio Tinio sa resulta sang hearing kahapon nga adlaw.

text: Ginmando ni South Korean President Lee Jae-myung ang madasig nga pagpauntat sang 700 billion Korean won loan support nga ginahatag sang ila gobyerno para sa mga ginatukod ng mga taytay sa Pilipinas kasunod sang paglupok sang isyu sa korapsyon.
english: South Korean President Lee Jae-myung has ordered the immediate suspension of the 700 billion Korean won loan support provided by his government for the construction of bridges in the Philippines following the eruption of corruption issues.

text: Sa isa ka Facebook post, ginpakigbahin ni Lee ang investigative report sang Hankyoreh 21 nga nagbuyagyag nga sang Nobyembre 2023, nag-file ang gobyerno sang Pilipinas sang aplikasyon para sa $510 milyon nga pautang halin sa sa Economic Development Cooperation Fund (EDCF) sang Korea para pondohan ang konstruksyon sang 350 steel modular bridges.
english: In a Facebook post, Lee shared Hankyoreh 21’s investigative report that revealed that in November 2023, the Philippine government filed an application for a $510 million loan from Korea’s Economic Development Cooperation Fund (EDCF) to fund the construction of 350 steel modular bridges.

text: Suno kay Lee, importante nga desisyon ang pagkauntat sa proyekto bangud nasalbar ang kapin 700 bilyong won nga kwarta sang pumuluyo sang South Korea para sa wala pulos nga gasto kag malikawan nga magamit lang ini sa korapsyon.
english: Lee said the suspension of the project was an important decision because it saved more than 700 billion won of South Korean people's money for unnecessary expenses and avoided it being used for corruption.

text: Gintuyo sang pila ka mga senador nga kumbinsehon si Senator Loren Legarda nga magbulos bilang Senate President.

english: According to Senate President Vicente Sotto III, Legarda, who is also from the majority, personally told him this information.

text: Apang suno kay Sotto, nagpasalig si Legarda nga indi ini interesado sa amo nga posisyon.

text: Wala man ginhingadlan kun sin-o halin sa minority ang nagpanguna sa amo nga tuyo nga kudeta.

english: Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano earlier acknowledged that there are discussions to change the leadership in the Senate, but for now, they cannot complete the number because they have not yet reached 13.

text: Gindepensahan naman ni Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo Lacson si Legarda sa tunga sang nagguwa nga mga impormasyon kasunod sang pagpamalibad sini nga magpungko bilang Senate leader.

text: Suno kay Lacson, sang napaslawan ang gintuyo nga kudeta, ginbaliskad sang iban ang lamesa kag ginpalapta ang istorya nga nag-boluntaryo si Legarda agud nga buligan ang iban nga mga senador nga magtipon sang suporta agud kakason si Sotto bilang Senate chief.
english: According to Lacson, when the attempted coup failed, some turned the table and spread the story that Legarda volunteered to help other senators gather support to remove Sotto as Senate chief.

text: Pahayag pa ni Lacson, lunsay malisyoso ini nga mga naratibo nga nagalapta.
english: Lacson said these narratives are all malicious.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni Sotto nga nagapabilin nga “solid” ang majority bloc apisar sang ginatan-aw sang iban nga posibilidad nga magabalhin si Legarda sang iya nga suporta.

text: Pahayag pa ni Sotto, may isa tubtub duha pa gani ka mga senador nga indi myembro sang majority bloc nga possible mag-upod sa ila.#

text: Antes nag-base sa New York, pila ka beses man nga nagpasakop sa local singing competitions si Vasquez nga ginapatihan man sini nga nangin lyabe man sa iya mga kadalag-an kaangay sang pagdaog sa Estados Unidos.
english: Before based in New York, Vasquez also participated several times in local singing competitions which he believes was also the key to his victories such as winning in the United States.

text: Ginpasalig ni Education Secretary Sonny Angara nga tutukan sang ahensya ang mga isyu kaangot sa mass promotion sa mga kabataan.
english: Education Secretary Sonny Angara assured that the agency will focus on issues related to mass promotion among children.

text: Kasunod ini sang panawagan sang Second Congressional Commission on Education (EDCOM 2) nga tapnaon gilayon ini nga practice bangud nagaka-pressure lamang ang mga manunudlo nga papasaron ang indi man kwalipikado nga mga estudyante agud lamang nga malab-ot nila ang ila nga administrative performance targets.
english: This follows the call of the Second Congressional Commission on Education (EDCOM 2) to immediately stop this practice because teachers are under pressure to pass ineligible students just to achieve their administrative performance targets.

text: Suno naman kay Angara, wala man sang partikular nga polisa sa mass promotion sa DepEd, apang nakahibalo siya nga may nakaandan nga buluhaton kaangay sang pag-tutor sang maestro kag maestra sa estudyante nga wala nakapasar.
english: Angara said there is no specific policy on mass promotion in the DepEd, but he knows that there are common activities such as tutoring teachers to students who failed.

text: Bangud sini suno sa tiglikom, ang tendency amo nga papasaron na lang ang bata.
english: Because of this, according to the secretary, the tendency is to pass the child.

text: Importante man suno kay Angara ang kolaborasyon sa Simbahan kag gobyerno para sa reporma sa edukasyon.
english: Angara said collaboration with the Church and government is also important for education reform.

text: Ginhalimbawa sini ang pag-partner sang DepEd sa nationwide network sang Caritas Philippines sa 86 diocesan social action centers.
english: He cited the DepEd's partnership with Caritas Philippines' nationwide network of 86 diocesan social action centers.

text: Bangud sini nga partnership suno sa iya, nag-uswag ang dalagku nga mga programa kaangay sang school-based feeding, learning recovery initiatives, kag Alternative Learning System.
english: Because of this partnership, he said, great programs such as school-based feeding, learning recovery initiatives, and Alternative Learning System have flourished.

text: Kun balikan, sa Comprehensive Rapid Literacy Assessment sa school year 2024-2025, nabulgar nga 48.76 percent sang learners ang indi pa makahibalo magbasa sa Grade 3.
english: In the Comprehensive Rapid Literacy Assessment for the 2024-2025 school year, it was revealed that 48.76 percent of learners do not know how to read in Grade 3.

text: Bisan nga 30.5 percent sang estudyante ang proficient sa amo sini nga level, amat-amat nga nagahina ang mastery samtang nagataas ang grade level tubtub nga nagasarurot na sa 0.40 percent sa Grade 12.
english: Although 30.5 percent of students are proficient at this level, mastery gradually declines as the grade level increases until it drops to 0.40 percent in Grade 12.

text: Ginsabat na ni John Estrada ang mga espekulasyon nga na-link siya sa young actress nga si Barbie Imperial.
english: John Estrada has addressed speculation that he was linked to young actress Barbie Imperial.

text: Sang damlag lamang nagguwa ang mga istorya nga nangin close ang duha samtang pareho nga nagabida sa primetime series nga FPJ’s Batang Quiapo.
english: Recently, stories surfaced that the two became close while both starred in the primetime series FPJ's Batang Quiapo.

text: Kadungan man ini sang mga pahayag nga medyo naglas-ayanay na si Barbie kag ang rumored boyfriend sini nga si Richard Gutierrez.
english: This also coincides with reports that Barbie and her rumored boyfriend Richard Gutierrez have been fighting for a while.

text: Sabat naman ni John, indi sila personal nga magkilalahay ni Barbie kag gintawag man sini nga fake news ang online posts nga naga-angot sa ila.
english: John replied that he and Barbie do not personally know each other and called the online posts about them fake news.

text: “Unang Una Hindi ko alam kung Sino o Saan nag simula ang Kalokohan na to, na naglilink sa amin ni barbie imperial,” suno sa actor.
english: "First of all, I don't know who or where this nonsense started, linking us to barbie imperial," the actor said.

text: Nagpahayag man sini nga isa ka bes lang sila nagkitaay para sa Christmas Special apang indi siya sigurado kun 2021 ukon 2022.
english: He also said that they only met once for the Christmas Special but he is not sure if it was 2021 or 2022.

text: Pahayag pa sini, bisan nga isa lang sila ka show, wala man sila nagakitaay bangud lain ang ila grupo, unit, kag director buot silingon, indi sila dungan sa mga eksena nga gina-shoot.
english: He said that even though they are in the same show, they do not meet because they have different groups, units, and directors, which means that they are not shooting the scenes together.

text: Nagpangabay man si John sa online entertainment websites nga mag-research man kag indi mag-basta-basta share sa publiko sang mga bagay nga 0.1% lamang ang kamatuoran.
english: John also urged online entertainment websites to do research and not to share things that are only 0.1% true.

text: “At sa mga online newspaper, o tabloid or tsismis sites, e bago nyo cguro ilabas ang isang bagay e mag research naman kayo kung merong kahit na 0.1 percent na katotohanan, yun lang po at maraming salamat (praying at heart emojis),” dugang sini.
english: "And to the online newspapers, or tabloids or gossip sites, before you publish something, do research if there is even 0.1 percent truth, that's all and thank you very much (praying and heart emojis)," he added.

text: Indi ini ang una nga bes nga na-link si John sa lain nga babaye apisar pa sang kasado sila sang Brazilian beauty queen nga si Priscilla Meirelles.
english: This is not the first time John has been linked to another woman despite being married to Brazilian beauty queen Priscilla Meirelles.

text: ‘Unbothered’ ang ginbansagan nga Pambansang Ginoo nga si David Licauco sa latest showbiz happenings.
english: 'Unbothered' the so-called Pambansang Tuhan David Licauco in the latest showbiz happenings.

text:
Sa iya latest Instagram photo, simple nga black shirt kag shorts ang suksok sini kag madamo ang naham-ot sa iya caption nga “Chill lang.”

Wala sang context sa caption sini apang may nagasunlog sa iya kaangay sang ‘Pulang Araw’ co-star sini nga si Derrick Monasterio nga nakahibalo siya kun ano ang buot silingon ni David: “Alam ko na to haha.”

Indi abi malikawan sang fans nga mamensyonar ang pangalan ni David sa online discussions kasunod sang pag-anunsyo ni Barbie Forteza nga bulagay na sila sang iya long-time boyfriend nga si Jak Roberto.
english:
In his latest Instagram photo, he was wearing a simple black shirt and shorts and many were inspired by his caption “Chill lang.”

There is no context in the caption but someone like his 'Pulang Araw' co-star Derrick Monasterio says he knows what David means: “I know that haha.”

Fans can't help but mention David's name in online discussions following Barbie Forteza's announcement that she and her long-time boyfriend Jak Roberto have broken up.

text: Wala sang ginhatag nga rason si Barbie kag wala man gihapon sang komento si Jak tubtub subong.
english: Barbie didn't give any reason and Jak still hasn't commented to this day.

text: Madumduman nga sang Disyembre, nahinambit naman ni David sa isa ka livestream sa iya bag-o nga coffee business nga single siya subong kag magapangita sang bag-o nga girlfriend.
english: In December, David mentioned in a livestream of his new coffee business that he is now single and looking for a new girlfriend.

text: Bisan pa sang tion nga magkarelasyon pa sanday Barbie kag Jak, kilala na ang chemistry sang BarDa ukon ang Barbie Forteza kag David Licauco tandem sa 2022 historical series nga Maria Clara at Ibarra tubtub sa Maging Sino Ka Man, Pulang Araw, kag That Kind of Love.
english: Even when Barbie and Jak were still in a relationship, the chemistry of BarDa or the Barbie Forteza and David Licauco tandem in the 2022 historical series Maria Clara at Ibarra to Maging Sino Ka Man, Pulang Araw, and That Kind of Love was well known.

text: Ginduso ni House Majority Leader Sandro Marcos ang isa ka hagna agud nga indi maswelduhan ang mga myembro sang Kongreso kun indi sila mag-trabaho.
english: House Majority Leader Sandro Marcos has proposed a bill to prevent members of Congress from being paid if they do not work.

text:
Gin-file sang Enero 27, 2026 ang House Bill 7432 ukon ang ginaproponer nga “No Work, No Pay for Members of Congress Act.”

Nakabutang sa coverage sini nga sakop sini ang tanan nga myembro sang Kongreso — buot silingon, ang mga yara sa Senado kag Kamara.
english:
Filed on January 27, 2026 was House Bill 7432 or the proposed “No Work, No Pay for Members of Congress Act.”

Its coverage includes all members of Congress — that is, those in the Senate and House.

text: Sa explanatory note sang kongresista, ginpahayag sini nga ginasunod ang “no work, no pay” nga patakaran sa tanan nga mamumugon sa pungsod.
english: In an explanatory note, the congressman said the “no work, no pay” policy is followed by all workers in the country.

text: Apang ginmuno niya nga ang mga myembro nga Kongreso — nga amo ang may katungdanan nga magbalay sang layi kag mag-represent sang mga tawo — ang gina-swelduhan sa gihapon apisar nga may attendance man sila ukon wala.
english: But he noted that members of Congress — who are responsible for drafting laws and representing the people — are still paid whether they have attendance or not.

text: Suno sa kongresista, uyang ini sa kuwarta sang pumuluyo nga nagabayad sang buwis.
english: According to the congressman, this is a waste of taxpayers' money.

text: “This has led to public concern over absenteeism, lack of accountability and wastage of taxpayer funds,” pahayag sang presidential son.
english: “This has led to public concern over absenteeism, lack of accountability and wastage of taxpayer funds,” the presidential son said.

text: Kun mapasar ini nga hagna suno pa kay Rep.
english: If this bill is passed, Rep.

text: Marcos, mas ma-promote ang transparency, accountability, kag integridad sa pang-gobyerno.
english: Marcos, will further promote transparency, accountability, and integrity in government.

text: Gindugang sini nga naka-provide sa iya nga ginaduso nga hagna ang “safeguards” sa valid nga mga rason sa pag-absent kaangay sang balatian ukon official representation duties.
english: He added that his proposed bill provides for “safeguards” on valid reasons for absence such as illness or official representation duties.

text: Wala sang ginhingadlan sa explanatory note ni Marcos, apang ang pinakamatunog nga kontrobersiya nga kaangot sini nga isyu sang damlag lang amo si Senator Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa.
english: No one was named in Marcos' explanatory note, but the most vocal controversy surrounding this issue recently was Senator Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa.

text: Madamo ang nagpakamalaot sa sistema bangud apisar wala nagapakita si Dela Rosa halin sang Nobyembre 2025, nagabaton gihapon siya sang sweldo.
english: Many criticized the system because although Dela Rosa does not appear from November 2025, he still receives a salary.

text: Nag-umpisa sa pag-absent si Dela Rosa sa mga session sang Senado halin sang naggwa ang impormasyon halin kay Ombudsman Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla nga naka-isyu na ang International Criminal Court (ICC) sang arrest warrant batok kay Dela Rosa nga amo ang PNP chief sang ginpatuman ang drug war.#
english: Dela Rosa has been absent from Senate sessions since information came out from Ombudsman Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla that the International Criminal Court (ICC) has issued an arrest warrant against Dela Rosa, who was the PNP chief when the drug war was implemented.

text: Mahimo matabo sa weekend ang debut ni Luka Doncic sa Los Angeles Lakers.
english: Luka Doncic's Los Angeles Lakers debut could happen over the weekend.

text: Sang sini lang nga semana sang ginsapubliko ang blockbuster trade sa National Basketball Association (NBA) nga nagsaylo kay Doncic sa Lakers halin sa Mavericks, kabaylo kay Anthony Davis nga didto na subong sa Dallas.
english: Just this week, the blockbuster trade in the National Basketball Association (NBA) was made public that moved Doncic to the Lakers from the Mavericks, in exchange for Anthony Davis who is now in Dallas.

text: Naka-upod na ang Slovenian superstar sa practice sang Lakers apang bangud sa iya gin-suprer nga calf injury, indi gihapon ini makaupod sa hampang batok sa Golden State Warriors 11:00 subong nga aga.
english: The Slovenian superstar has already joined the Lakers' practice but due to a calf injury he suffered, he will still not be able to join the game against the Golden State Warriors at 11:00 this morning.

text: Apang suno kay coach JJ Redick, posible nga makahampang na ang anay NBA scoring champion batok sa Indiana Pacers 5:00 sang aga sa Domingo oras sa Pilipinas, ukon batok sa Utah Jazz 11:30 sang aga sa Martes oras gihapon sa Pilipinas.
english: However, according to coach JJ Redick, it is possible that the former NBA scoring champion will be able to play against the Indiana Pacers at 5:00 am on Sunday, or against the Utah Jazz at 11:30 am on Tuesday.

text: Matandaan nga wala na naka-upod hampang si Luka sa Mavericks subong nga 2025 matapos ang naangkon nga injury sang Christmas Day.
english: Luka has been ruled out for the Mavericks in 2025 after suffering an injury on Christmas Day.

text: Labing-isang tao, kabilang ang mga kababaihan, mga batang babae, at isang sanggol, ang naiulat na nawawala matapos tumaob ang sinasakyang bangka sa Ilog Sassandra sa timog-kanlurang bahagi ng Côte d’Ivoire, matapos hampasin ng isang hippopotamus, ayon sa ulat ng pamahalaan nitong Sabado.
english: Eleven people, including women, girls, and an infant, were reported missing after a boat capsized in the Sassandra River in southwestern Côte d'Ivoire, after being attacked by a hippopotamus, according to a government report on Saturday.

text: Ayon kay Myss Belmonde Dogo, West African nation’s minister for national cohesion and solidarity Côte d’Ivoire, tinamaan ng hippopotamus ang makitid na bangka na kahalintulad ng canoe habang ito ay umaandar sa ilog malapit sa bayan ng Buyo noong Biyernes.
english: According to Miss Belmonde Dogo, West African nation's minister for national cohesion and solidarity Côte d'Ivoire, a hippopotamus hit a narrow canoe-like boat while it was moving in the river near the town of Buyo on Friday.

text: Tatlong katao lamang ang nailigtas sa insidente, habang nagpapatuloy pa rin ang malawakang search and rescue operation para matagpuan ang iba pang nawawalang pasahero.
english: Only three people were rescued from the incident, while an extensive search and rescue operation is still underway to find the other missing passengers.

text: Kabilang sa mga nawawala ang ilang babae, mga batang babae, at isang sanggol, ayon sa ulat ng opisyal.
english: Among the missing were several women, girls, and an infant, according to the official report.

english: According to a 2022 study by researchers from a university in Côte d'Ivoire, the hippopotamus is the most frequently recorded animal involved in incidents of death or injury in the country.

text: Tinatayang mayroong humigit-kumulang 500 hippopotamus sa Côte d’Ivoire, karamihan sa mga ito ay matatagpuan sa mga pangunahing ilog gaya ng Sassandra at Bandama.
english: It is estimated that there are approximately 500 hippopotamuses in Côte d'Ivoire, most of which are found in the main rivers such as the Sassandra and Bandama.

text: Karaniwan din ang mga aksidente sa mga ilog ng bansa, bunsod ng paggamit ng mga bangkang gawa sa kahoy na karaniwang ginagamit bilang pangunahing transportasyon sa mga komunidad sa tabing-ilog.
english: Accidents are also common in the country's rivers, due to the use of wooden boats that are commonly used as the main transportation in riverside communities.

english: These are often overloaded, posing a danger to passengers.

text:

DOH Epidemiology Bureau director Dr. Chito Avelino
the statement of Dr. Domingo to say that it is more contagious

text:

There is a higher transmission, or rate of
infection, it is than nCoV, he said.

text:
Ang isa ka infected sang measles pwede ka infect sang 18 ka tawo,
samtang ang nCoV maka-infect lang sang 2 tubtub 4 sa iya palibut kag ina sa
close range pa (mga 6 ka tapak halin sa kaatubang).
english:
One person infected with measles can infect 18 people,
while nCoV can only infect 2 to 4 in its environment and that in
close range (about 6 feet from the other person).

text:
***

Mga research data nagapamatuod sa ginsiling ni Dr. Domingo nga daku ang

ikaayong lawas (health) kag wala pondo nga masakit nga makapahuyang.

***

Research data confirms what Dr. Sunday was a big
chances of recovery for someone infected with nCoV as long as they are doing well
health and unfunded diseases that are debilitating.

According to the global tracking of John Hopkins University (Resarch university
in the United States) on January 31, 2020,

9,776 are infected showing gradual recovery.

These 213 deaths are only about two percent (2%) of the

4, 2020, sa diin 425 na ang napatay kag 20,438 ang

4, 2020, with 425 deaths and 20,438

Noel Palomado, Bombo Abogado, iya ginpahayag nga ang executive clemency nga ginhatag kay Mabilog ang kaangot lang sa desisyon sang Office of the Ombudsman bangud sa “dishonesty” bangud sa iya ginapahayag tago nga manggad nga gin-file ni anay Iloilo Provincial Administrator Manuel ‘Boy’ Mejorada.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Noel Palomado, Bombo Abogado, said the executive clemency granted to Mabilog is only in connection with the decision of the Office of the Ombudsman due to “dishonesty” due to his alleged hidden wealth filed by former Iloilo Provincial Administrator Manuel 'Boy' Mejorada.

text: Suno kay Palomado, ang paghatag sang executive clemency kay Mabilog ang ginbase sa iya mayo nga pagdumala, mga awards nga nabaton kag pagkilala nga nabaton sang Iloilo City sa idalom sang iya pagpamuno.
english: According to Palomado, the granting of executive clemency to Mabilog was based on his good governance, awards received and recognition received by Iloilo City under his leadership.

text: Bangud sa executive clemency, mahimo na nga magpadalagan si Mabilog sa anuman nga posisyon sa gobyerno.
english: Thanks to the executive clemency, Mabilog can now run for any government position.

text: Apang sa pihak sini, nagapangatubang sa gihapon si Mabilog sang kaso nga graft sa Sandiganbayan nga ginpasaka sa ila ni anay Iloilo City Councilor Plaridel Nava II sang Office of the Ombudsman sang 2023.
english: However, Mabilog is still facing a graft case in the Sandiganbayan filed against them by former Iloilo City Councilor Plaridel Nava II of the Office of the Ombudsman in 2023.

text: Kaangot ini sa ila kahilabtanan sa pag-award sang isa ka kontrata sang gobyerno sa isa ka firm nga ginapahayag may kaangtanan sa ila.
english: This is in connection with their involvement in the award of a government contract to a firm allegedly linked to them.

text: Sang Setyembre, nagpyansa si Mabilog kaangot sa kaso sini nga graft.
english: In September, Mabilog posted bail in connection with the graft case.

text: Kun anuman ang mangin desisyon sini, gin-athag sang abogado nga indi na ini sakop sang executive clemency.
english: Whatever the decision, the lawyer explained that it is no longer covered by executive clemency.

text: Guilty ka man sa masami nga pag-picture picture kun may makit-an ikaw nga espiho?
english: Are you guilty of often taking pictures when you see a mirror?

text: Madamo gid sa aton ang nanamian sa mirror selfies, ilabi na kun feel na feel gid naton ang aton OOTD ukon ang aton nga Outfit of the Day!
english: Many of us love mirror selfies, especially when we feel our OOTD or our Outfit of the Day!

text: Sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika, ginpangkakas na ini nga mga espiho sa mga restroom sa rason nga nagabalik-balik ang mga estudyante kag nagakadugayan bangud sa ila pag-video-video sang ila nga mga saot!
english: In the United States of America, these mirrors have been removed from the restrooms on the grounds that students are coming back and forth because of their video-video of their dances!

text: Natabo ini sa Alamance Burlington School System sa North Carolina.
english: It happened in the Alamance Burlington School System in North Carolina.

text: Sa average suno sa opisyal sang eskwelahan, tag-apat lamang ka beses nga naga-guwa ang estudyante agud nga magkadto sa CR.
english: On average, according to the school official, students only go out four times to go to the CR.

text: Apang sang ulihi, natalupangdan sang mga manunulo nga daw naga-pito tubtub siyam ka beses gid nga naga-guwa ang ila estudyante kag nagakadugayan pa antes magbalik.
english: But later, the teachers noticed that their student seemed to go out seven to nine times and wait longer before returning.

text: Bangud natukiban nga nanamian gali ang mga estudyante nga mag-shoot sang ila TikTok videos sa mga espiho sa restroom, ginpangkakas ini sang eskwelahan sang nagligad lamang nga semana.
english: After discovering that students actually enjoyed shooting their TikTok videos in the restroom mirrors, the school removed them last week.

text: Natabo man ini sa Piedmont Triad Middle School nga yara man gihapon sa state sang North Carolina.
english: It also happened at Piedmont Triad Middle School which is also still in the state of North Carolina.

text: Suno sa eskwelahan, positibo ang resulta sang ginpangkuha nila ang mga espiho sa ila restrooms bangud wala sang nagapakadto-pakari nga mga estudyante agud mag-CR kag wala sang nagapalawig sa sulod.
english: According to the school, the results were positive when they removed the mirrors in their restrooms because there were no students coming and going to use the bathroom and no one was staying inside.

text: Gintay-og sang Lakers kag Mavericks ang NBA world matapos gin-reporr nga nahitso na ang negosasyon para i-trade si Luka Doncic sa Los Angeles samtang isaylo naman si Anthony Davis sa Dallas.
english: The Lakers and Mavericks shook the NBA world after it was reported that negotiations to trade Luka Doncic to Los Angeles while Anthony Davis to Dallas have been completed.

text: Tumalagsahon ini nga trade nga wala ginahauman subong nga tuig ilabi na samtang nagapadayon ang All-NBA selections.
english: This is an unusual trade that is not being made this year especially as the All-NBA selections continue.

text: Magluwas sa pagbaylo sang duha ka players, makuha man sang Lakers sanday Maxi Kleber kag Markieff Morris, samtang batunon naman sang Mavericks si Max Christie kag ang first-round draft pick sa 2029.
english: In addition to trading two players, the Lakers will also get Maxi Kleber and Markieff Morris, while the Mavericks will receive Max Christie and a first-round draft pick in 2029.

text: Mabaton naman sang Utah Jazz si Jalen Hood-Schifino, 2025 second-round pick via Los Angeles Clippers kag ang 2025 second-round pick sang Mavs.
english: The Utah Jazz will receive Jalen Hood-Schifino, a 2025 second-round pick via the Los Angeles Clippers and the 2025 second-round pick of the Mavs.

text: Base sa reports, ang Mavs ang nagtanyag sa Lakers nga i-trade si Doncic, samtang nagapati naman ang Los Angeles nga ang five-time All Star player ang sarang mangin nawong sa ila nga franchise sa palaabuton.
english: According to reports, the Mavs have offered the Lakers to trade Doncic, while Los Angeles believes the five-time All Star player could be the face of their franchise in the future.

text: Pananglitan mangin pormal na ang trade, makita si Doncic nga magahampang sa Los Angeles kaupod si LeBron James sa iya ika-22 na nga NBA season.
english: If the trade is formalized, Doncic will be seen playing in Los Angeles alongside LeBron James in his 22nd NBA season.

text: Pareho nga wala nakahampang subong sa ila teams sanday Doncic kag Davis bangud sa injuries.
english: Both Doncic and Davis are currently out for their teams due to injuries.

text: Suno sa Mavs, isa ka bulan pa ang kinahanglan nga pahuway ni Doncic samtang sa masunod nga semana naman ang reevaluation kay Davis.
english: According to the Mavs, Doncic will need to rest for another month while Davis will be reevaluated next week.

text: Nahibaluan nga may 28-19 record ang Lakers sa Western Conference samtang may 26-23 naman ang Mavs sa latest figures halin sa amo man nga conference sa liga.
english: The Lakers have a 28-19 record in the Western Conference while the Mavs have a 26-23 record in the latest figures from the same conference in the league.

text: Nagakaon ka bala sang sambag?
english: Do you eat sambag?

text: Kilala nga pampaaslom sa sabaw kag iban pa nga putahe ang bunga sang sambag.
english: Sambag fruit is known as a spice for soups and other dishes.

text: Apang indi lang sa pagluto may yara sang pulos ang sambag bangud epektibo man ini nga bulong kontra sa balatian bangud may yara ini sang bitamina kag mineral.
english: But sambag is not only useful in cooking because it is also an effective medicine against diseases because it contains vitamins and minerals.

text: Suno kay Algy Bacla sang Philippine Academy of Naturopathic Medicine, epektibo nga bulong ang sambag sa anemia ukon kulang sa dugo nga nagatuga sang pagpalanghina.
english: According to Algy Bacla of the Philippine Academy of Naturopathic Medicine, sambag is an effective remedy for anemia or lack of blood that causes weight loss.

text: Kun may yara naman ikaw sang sakit sa baga, almoranas, hilanat, sip-on kag mga impeksyon, magpabukal ka lang sang dahon kag panit sang sambag sa isa ka litro nga tubig.
english: If you have lung disease, hemorrhoids, fever, cough and infections, just boil the leaves and bark of sambag in one liter of water.

text: Ikaw bala ang may hypertension?
english: Are you the one with hypertension?

text: Indi magkabalaka bangud ang sambag ang may yara sang proanthocyanidins nga amo ang nagabulig sa pag-refresh sang blood circulation.
english: Don't worry because sambag contains proanthocyanidins that help refresh blood circulation.

text: Itinuturing ng Pilipinas ang sarili bilang key player sa lumalaking cruise tourism network ng ASEAN matapos ang matagumpay na ASEAN Tourism Forum (ATF) 2026 sa Cebu.
english: The Philippines considers itself as a key player in ASEAN's growing cruise tourism network after the successful ASEAN Tourism Forum (ATF) 2026 in Cebu.

text: Ayon kay Tourism Secretary Christina Garcia-Frasco, itinuring ng ASEAN tourism ministers ang cruise tourism bilang pangunahing produkto sa ilalim ng ASEAN Tourism Strategic Plan, na maaaring magbukas ng multi-country itineraries at magpakilala sa mga isla ng Pilipinas sa mga banyagang turista.
english: According to Tourism Secretary Christina Garcia-Frasco, ASEAN tourism ministers have identified cruise tourism as a key product under the ASEAN Tourism Strategic Plan, which can open up multi-country itineraries and introduce the Philippine islands to foreign tourists.

text: Kasama sa plano ang pag-promote ng cruise tourism kasama ang heritage at culture, gastronomy, health and wellness, at nature and adventure tourism, upang makalikha ng seamless at mataas na kalidad na travel experiences sa buong rehiyon.
english: The plan includes the promotion of cruise tourism along with heritage and culture, gastronomy, health and wellness, and nature and adventure tourism, to create seamless and high quality travel experiences throughout the region.

text: Binanggit ni Frasco ang mga hakbang na ginawa ng Pilipinas, kabilang ang natapos na cruise port sa Siargao at mga proyekto kasama ang Philippine Ports Authority para mapalawak ang cruise-ready destinations.
english: Frasco mentioned the steps taken by the Philippines, including the completed cruise port in Siargao and projects with the Philippine Ports Authority to expand cruise-ready destinations.

text: Ayon sa Bureau of Immigration, mahigit 56,000 cruise tourists ang bumisita sa bansa, karamihan ay first-time visitors.
english: According to the Bureau of Immigration, more than 56,000 cruise tourists visited the country, most of them first-time visitors.

text: Bukod sa cruise tourism, sinabi ni Frasco na ang matagumpay na ATF ay nagpapatibay sa suporta para sa regional connectivity, kabilang ang mas maraming air at sea routes, at binigyang-diin ang kahalagahan ng public-private partnerships para sa infrastructure, tulad ng airport upgrades sa Laguindingan, Puerto Princesa, at Iloilo.
english: Aside from cruise tourism, Frasco said the successful ATF is strengthening support for regional connectivity, including more air and sea routes, and emphasized the importance of public-private partnerships for infrastructure, such as airport upgrades in Laguindingan, Puerto Ilo Princesa.

text: Nagpaandam ang Bureau of Animal Industry (BAI) batok sa paglapta sang mga indi rehistrado nga pet food products nga ginabaligya online lakip na sa bantog nga e-commerce platforms kag sa TikTok.
english: The Bureau of Animal Industry (BAI) has warned against the spread of unregistered pet food products being sold online including on popular e-commerce platforms and on TikTok.

text: Sa advisory sang ahensya, ginsiling nga nakumpirma sa ila nga post-marketing surveillance kag verification sang records nga may nagkalain-lain nga mga produkto online nga kulang sa husto nga certification.
english: In the agency's advisory, it said it was confirmed in their post-marketing surveillance and verification of records that there are various products online that lack proper certification.

text: Ginpahayag man nga indi ma-identify kun sin-o ang suppliers.
english: It was also stated that the suppliers could not be identified.

text: Gina-abisuhan ang mga tag-iya sini nga produkto nga magpakig-angot sa BAI kag sa Food and Drug Administration, ilabi na sa items nga may therapeutic claims agud nga masiguro ang proper evaluation kag registration.
english: Owners of this product are advised to contact the BAI and the Food and Drug Administration, especially with items with therapeutic claims to ensure proper evaluation and registration.

text: Pahayag pa sang bureau, indi man dapat pagbaklon kag i-promote sang pet owners ang unregistered feed products tubtub nga ma-certify na ini sang BAI kag FDA.
english: The bureau said pet owners should not buy and promote unregistered feed products until they are certified by the BAI and FDA.

text: Lakip sa unregistered products kag brands nga nadiskubrehan sang BAI amo ang veTcore+, Fit Paws, Tovitar, Popoo kag Petcher Organics.
english: Among the unregistered products and brands discovered by the BAI were veTcore+, Fit Paws, Tovitar, Popoo and Petcher Organics.

text: Lakip sa items ang pagkaon sang ido, produkto para sa pagpanami pa sa fur, hip and joint health, kag gut health sang hinuptanan, kag naga-claim man nga maka-boost sang immunity.
english: The items include dog food, products for fur grooming, hip and joint health, and pet gut health, and also claim to boost immunity.

text: Nahibaluan nga isa sa pinakadasig sa market sa Pilipinas subong ang pet food rason nga nagsulod naman ang domestic animal feed makers sa pet food products para maislan ang nadula nga demand halin sa traditional markets.
english: Pet food is one of the fastest growing markets in the Philippines, which is why domestic animal feed makers have entered pet food products to replace the lost demand from traditional markets.

text: Ginabanta sang industry players nga ang pet food market sa pungsod ang nagadangat sa P24 billion kag mas nagadaku sa kada tuig.
english: Industry players estimate that the pet food market in the country reaches P24 billion and is growing every year.

text: Duha ka mabaskog nga aftershocks ang nag-igo sa Afghanistan sa nakaligad nga 12 ka oras kahapon nga adlaw.
english: Two strong aftershocks hit Afghanistan in the past 12 hours yesterday.

text: Kasunod ini sang mabaskog nga magnitude 6.0 nga linog nga nagtay-og sa pungsod sang nagligad nga apat ka adlaw, nga nagpatay sang 2,205 ka tawo kag nagpilas sang 3,640.
english: It follows a powerful magnitude 6.0 earthquake that rocked the country four days ago, killing 2,205 people and injuring 3,640.

text: Ginakabalak-an nga magataas pa ang numero sang mga nagkalamatay kag pilason kasunod sang mabaskog nga aftershocks.
english: The number of dead and injured is feared to rise following the strong aftershocks.

text: Suno sa report sang lokal nga media, padayon nga naga-igo ang aftershocks sa probinsya sang Nangarhar kag ginahibalo pa ang mga detalye sang halit nga gintuga sang mabaskog nga aftershocks.
english: According to local media reports, aftershocks continue to hit Nangarhar province and details of the damage caused by the strong aftershocks are still being determined.

text: Nagpaandam man ang United Nation kag iban pa nga mga ahensya sang isa ka kritikal nga kinahanglanon para sa pundo, pagkaon, medical supplies kag puluy-an para sa mga nakalampuwas sa linog.
english: The United Nations and other agencies have also warned of a critical need for funds, food, medical supplies and shelter for earthquake survivors.

text: Bilang sabat, ang World Health Organization (WHO) naga-apelar sang $4 milyones nga pondo para sa mga biktima sang linog sa Afghanistan.
english: In response, the World Health Organization (WHO) is appealing for $4 million in funding for earthquake victims in Afghanistan.

text: Puno sang kalipay ang Pinoy pole vault superstar nga si Ernest John “EJ” Obiena bangud wala na ini sang nabatyagan nga kasakit sa iya likod sang nagbalik ini sa international competition subong nga 2025.
english: Pinoy pole vault superstar Ernest John “EJ” Obiena is full of joy because he no longer feels pain in his back when he returned to international competition this 2025.

text: Nagpangaduha si Obiena sa International Jump Meeting Cottbus sa Germany sang nagligad nga semana nga amo ang iya una nga medalya halin sang nakaangkon ang back injury nga amo ang nag-utod sang iya produktibo nga 2024 season.
english: Obiena finished second at the International Jump Meeting Cottbus in Germany last week which was his first medal since suffering the back injury that cut short his productive 2024 season.

text: Pahayag sang two-time Olympian, na-clear na ang iya injury sang Oktubre kag amat-amat siya nga nagabalik sa kasakuon sang sports lakip na ang wala-tuo nga training.
english: The two-time Olympian said he was cleared of his injury in October and is slowly returning to sports activities including left-handed training.

text: Positibo man siya sa iya mga plano subong nga tuig lakip ang pagpasakop sa World Indoor Championships sa China sa Marso; Asian Championships sa Korea sa Mayo; sa World Outdoor Championship sa Japan sa Septyembre; kag sa Southeast Asian Games sa Thailand sa Disyembre kun sa diin natalana sini nga depensahan ang iya titulo.
english: She is also positive about her plans this year including competing at the World Indoor Championships in China in March; Asian Championships in Korea in May; at the World Outdoor Championships in Japan in September; and the Southeast Asian Games in Thailand in December where he is scheduled to defend his title.

text: Matandaan nga antes pa man ang Paris Olympics, may ginabatas na ini nga injury apang nag-compete gihapon kag nagpang-apat sa kumpetisyon.
english: Even before the Paris Olympics, he was suffering from an injury but still competed and finished fourth in the competition.

text: Pabor si 2nd District Board Member June Mondejar sa pagbalik sang initial screening sa mga pasahero sa Iloilo International Airport.
english: 2nd District Board Member June Mondejar is in favor of the return of initial screening of passengers at Iloilo International Airport.

text: Ini kasunod ini sang insidente nga natabo sang ligad nga shooting incident matapos nangtaya ang isa ka pasahero sang kutsilyo sa sulod sang airport.
english: This follows the incident that occurred in the past shooting incident after a passenger staked a knife inside the airport.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mondejar, bilang Chair sang Committee on Public Order and Safety, iya ginpahayag nga kinahanglan nga unahon ang seguridad sang mga pasahero antes ang convenience.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mondejar, as Chair of the Committee on Public Order and Safety, said that the safety of passengers should be given priority before convenience.

text: Dugang pa niya, indi pwede nga isakripisyo ang seguridad sang mga pasahero sa pagpadali lang sang proseso sa pagpasulod sa airport.
english: He added that the security of passengers cannot be sacrificed just to speed up the process of entering the airport.

text: Suno sa iya, ang pagbalik sang initial screening isa ka importante nga tikang agud mapabaskog ang seguridad sang publiko.
english: He said the resumption of initial screening is an important step to bolster public safety.

text: Dugang pa niya nga kun may isa ka indibidwal nga may plano nga magbuhat sang malain kinahanglan nga duwa ka screening ang agyan sini agud mangin gamay ang tsansa sini nga makahimo sang bisan ano nga malain nga plano antes pa makalab-ot sa pinakahulihi nga screening.
english: He added that if an individual has a plan to do something wrong, he should go through two screenings to reduce his chances of committing any wrong plan before reaching the last screening.

text: Suno pa sa iya nga naga-akomodar na ang Iloilo International Airport sang madamo nga mga international flights kag kinahanglan nga na-preparar na ang mga pasilidad nga kinahanglanon agud nga mangin matalunsay ang pag-proseso sang mga pasahero sa ila pagbyahe.

text: Gumamit ng teargas at stun grenades ang pulisya sa Serbia upang ipagtabuyan ang libu-libong nagpoprotesta sa unibersidad sa Novi Sad na nananawagan ng snap elections para mapatalsik si Pangulong Aleksandar Vucic at ang kanyang Serbian Progressive Party (SNS).
english: Serbian police used tear gas and stun grenades to disperse thousands of protesters at the university in Novi Sad who called for snap elections to oust President Aleksandar Vucic and his Serbian Progressive Party (SNS).

text: Ayon kay Vucic, labing-isang pulis ang nasaktan sa kaguluhan ngunit walang inilabas na opisyal na bilang kung ilang sibilyan ang napinsala.
english: According to Vucic, eleven policemen were injured in the riots but no official number was released as to how many civilians were injured.

text: Nagtipon ang mga raliyista sa campus ng state university na may dalang plakard na may nakasulat na “We don’t want blockades, we want elections” at “Students have one urgent demand: Call elections.” Sumigaw din ang mga ito ng “Vucic, leave!” habang nagkagirian sa harap ng philosophy faculty.
english: The rallyists gathered on the campus of the state university carrying placards reading “We don’t want blockades, we want elections” and “Students have one urgent demand: Call elections.” They also shouted “Vucic, leave!” while fighting in front of the philosophy faculty.

text: Pinaniniwalaang galing sa hanay ng mga estudyante, oposisyon, at anti-corruption groups ang mga lumahok sa kilos-protesta.
english: The protesters are believed to be from the ranks of students, opposition, and anti-corruption groups.

text: Itinuturo nila ang umano’y korapsyon bilang ugat ng trahedya sa Novi Sad railway station kung saan 16 katao ang namatay matapos bumagsak ang bubong noong Nobyembre.
english: They point to alleged corruption as the root cause of the tragedy at the Novi Sad railway station where 16 people were killed after the roof collapsed in November.

text: Sinabi ni Vucic na hindi niya papayagang masira ang mga institusyon ng estado at inakusahan ang mga banyagang intelligence services na nasa likod ng protesta.
english: Vucic said he would not allow state institutions to be destroyed and accused foreign intelligence services of being behind the protests.

text: Nag-anunsyo rin siya na magsasagawa ng mga rally ang kanyang mga tagasuporta sa iba’t ibang lungsod sa Linggo.
english: He also announced that his supporters will hold rallies in various cities on Sunday.

text: Nitong mga nakaraang buwan, patuloy ang mga kilos-protesta laban kay Vucic, karamihan ay mapayapa hanggang noong Agosto 13 nang magkaroon ng marahas na banggaan sa pagitan ng pulis at mga sibilyan.
english: In recent months, protests against Vucic continued, mostly peaceful until August 13 when there was a violent clash between police and civilians.

text: Giit ng mga nagpoprotesta, ang solusyon sa krisis ay agarang pagtawag ng halalan upang magkaroon ng panibagong pamahalaan.
english: Protesters say the solution to the crisis is to call elections immediately to form a new government.

text: Nakuha ni Ernest John “EJ” Obiena ang silver medal sa iya labing-una nga pagbalik sa international pole vault competition halin sang nagpahuway sang 2024 bangud sa back injury.
english: Ernest John “EJ” Obiena won the silver medal in his first return to international pole vault competition since retiring in 2024 due to a back injury.

text: Nagpasakop ang Pinoy Olympian sa International Springer-Meeting Cottbus sa Germany kun sa diin na-clear sini ang 5.65-meters.
english: The Pinoy Olympian competed in the International Springer-Meeting Cottbus in Germany where he cleared 5.65-meters.

text: Mahapos sini nga na-clear ang 5.40, 5.55, kag 5.65 bars antes nagpaiway sa 5.70 meters kag nagtinguha pa kuntani sa 5.75 meters apang napaslawan sang tatlo ka beses.
english: He easily cleared 5.40, 5.55, and 5.65 bars before avoiding 5.70 meters and trying for 5.75 meters but failed three times.

text: Nagpangaduha si EJ sa American kag Paris Olympics silver medalist nga si Sam Kendricks nga isahanon nga nakalukso sang 5.75 meters.
english: EJ finished second to American and Paris Olympics silver medalist Sam Kendricks with a solo jump of 5.75 meters.

text: Madumduman nga Agusto sang gin-anunsyo sang Pinoy athlete nga temprano sini nga tapuson ang 2024 season bangud sa injury nga nagakinahanglan gid sang pahuway.
english: It can be recalled that in August, the Filipino athlete announced that he would end the 2024 season early due to an injury that required rest.

text: Bangud sadto, wala ini nakaupod sa iban pa nga mga kumpetisyon kag wala man nadayon ang Philippine International Pole Vault Challenge nga iya kuntani ginplano para sa Septyembre.
english: As a result, he was unable to participate in other competitions and the Philippine International Pole Vault Challenge that he had planned for September was cancelled.

text: Ang amo man nga injury ang ginbatas sini samtang nagapreparar sa Paris Olympics, kun sa diin nagkabos ini nga makakuha sang medalya matapos nagpang-apat sang gin-rank na ang players via countback.
english: He suffered the same injury while preparing for the Paris Olympics, where he narrowly missed out on a medal after finishing fourth when the players were ranked via countback.

text: Nag-us-os man ang Asian record holder sa rank number 4 halin sa pangaduha nga pwesto sa world rankings nga iya gina-uyatan antes ang Olympiada.
english: The Asian record holder also dropped to rank number 4 from the second place in the world rankings he held before the Olympics.

text: Ginkakas sang World Health Organization (WHO) ang MPOX bilang international health emergency.
english: The World Health Organization (WHO) has declared MPOX an international health emergency.

text: Suno kay WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, ang desisyon ang base sa padayon nga pagnubo sang kaso.
english: WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said the decision was based on the continued decline in cases.

text: Pila sa mga pungsod nga pinaka-apektuhan sang virus amo ang Democratic Republic of the Congo kag mga kaiping nga pungsod.
english: Some of the countries most affected by the virus are the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring countries.

text: Mahibaluan, ang virus ang nagalaton paagi sa physical contact, sa diin ang mga ma-expose ang maga-develop sang flu-like symptoms.
english: The virus is transmitted through physical contact, where those exposed will develop flu-like symptoms.

text: Kun ikaw first-timer sa pagbyahe sakay sa eroplano, isa gid sa ginakalangkagan mo ang pagpanghangaw-hangaw sa mga panganod, pag-enjoy sa sunrise ukon sunset, ukon bisan pa pag-inom-inom sa imo kape samtang nagahulat nga makaabot sa imo destinasyon.
english: If you are a first-timer to travel by plane, one of the things you look forward to is gazing at the clouds, enjoying the sunrise or sunset, or even sipping your coffee while waiting to reach your destination.

text: Kun naanad ka naman sa eroplano, siguro gusto mo lang magpahuway ukon magpiyong-piyong samtang naga-byahe.
english: If you're used to flying, you probably just want to rest or close your eyes while traveling.

text: Apang wala gid siguro sang nanamian nga magtinir sa comfort room sa bilog nga byahe, ilabi na kun masobra sa isa ka oras!
english: But I don’t think anyone enjoys staying in the comfort room for the entire flight, especially if it’s more than an hour!

text: Pero amo sini ang natabo sa isa ka pasahero sa India sang nagsulod ini sa comfort room, apang wala na naka-guwa bangud sa pag-malfunction sang puertahan!
english: But this is what happened to a passenger in India when he entered the comfort room, but was unable to leave due to a malfunction of the door!

text: Halin ang lalaki sa syudad sang Mumbai kag pakadto kuntani sa syudad sang Bengaluru — byahe nga nagalawig sang 105 minutos.
english: The man was from Mumbai city and was going to Bengaluru city — a journey that takes 105 minutes.

text: Naghalin sila sa Mumbai sang pasado las dos sa kaagahon.
english: They left Mumbai at around 2 am.

text: Ginpahayag nga nakapadala man ang pasahero sang distress call kag naghulag man ang crew agud buligan siya sa sulod sang CR apang indi gid mabuksan ang lock.
english: The passenger also sent a distress call and the crew moved to help him inside the CR but the lock could not be opened.

text: Sang ulihi, may ginpalusot nga gamay sa papel sa comfort room kun sa diin ginsilingan ang pasahero nga indi mabuksan ang puertahan apang indi ini dapat mag-panic.
english: Later, a small piece of paper was slipped into the comfort room where the passenger was told that the door could not be opened but he should not panic.

text: Gin-abisuhan man ang pasahero nga magpungko lamang bangud kun makahugpa na ang eroplano, magatawag sila sang engineer agud mabuksan ang puerta.
english: Passengers were also advised to sit down because when the plane lands, they will call an engineer to open the door.

text: Sang nag-abot na sa airport, ginpasulod matuod ang duha ka engineer kag ila ginguba ang puerta.
english: When they arrived at the airport, the two engineers were indeed allowed in and they broke down the door.

text: Ginpahayag nga yara sa state of shock ang lalaki kag ginhatagan man ini sang medical support.
english: The man was reportedly in a state of shock and was also given medical support.

text: Nagtanyag man ang airline company sang full refund bangud indi nangin maayo ang eksperyensya sini sa byahe.
english: The airline company also offered a full refund because the flight experience was not good.

text: Wala na sang madamo nga detalye nga ginpaguwa ang airline apang nag-isyu ini sang public apology bangud sa amo nga hitabo.
english: The airline did not release many details but issued a public apology for the incident.

text: Gin-ambush sang wala pa nakilala nga indibidwal ang 11 ka myembro sang isa ka pamilya sa San Pablo City, Laguna.
english: An unidentified individual ambushed 11 members of a family in San Pablo City, Laguna.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, sakay sa multi-purpose vehicle ang mga biktima sang ginpaulanan sila sang bala.
english: According to the investigation, the victims were riding in a multi-purpose vehicle when they were shot.

text: Maswerte nga wala sang may naigo sang bala sa mga sakay nga sanday Homaima Bacarat, 42, nga amo ang driver, kaupod ang iya utod, tiya, apat ka bata nga nagaedad 10, 9,7, 3 kag apat pa ka mga babaye.
english: Fortunately, none of the passengers, Homaima Bacarat, 42, the driver, along with her brother, aunt, four children aged 10, 9, 7, 3 and four other girls were hit by bullets.

text: Sakay sa motorsiklo ang lalaki nga nangluthang.
english: The man who shot was riding a motorcycle.

text: Nakilala naman sang mga biktima ang gunman paagi sa nawong sini apang wala pa matumod ang pangalan sini.
english: The victims recognized the gunman by his face but his name has not been released.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon agud mahibaluan ang motibo sa ambush.
english: Investigation is ongoing to determine the motive of the ambush.

text: Nakumpirma sa imbestigasyon ng pulisya na ginahasa at pinatay ang isang dalaga sa Barangay Owak, Calinog, Iloilo na una umanong inakalang nagpakamatay.
english: Police investigation confirmed that a young woman was raped and killed in Barangay Owak, Calinog, Iloilo.

text: Ang biktima ay 18 taong gulang, habang ang suspek ay mismong tiyuhin niya na 27 taong gulang.
english: The victim is 18 years old, while the suspect is his own uncle who is 27 years old.

text: Ang suspek ay residente ng naturang lugar at ikalawang pinsan ng ina ng biktima.
english: The suspect is a resident of the same area and the second cousin of the victim's mother.

text: Sa panayam ng Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Myles Dieron, hepe ng Calinog Municipal Police Station, sinabi niyang nakatanggap sila ng tawag mula sa isang ospital dahil may dinalang pasyente na umano’y nagpakamatay.
english: When contacted by Bombo Radyo, Police Major Myles Dieron, chief of the Calinog Municipal Police Station, said they received a call from a hospital because a patient was brought in who allegedly committed suicide.

text: Sa isinagawang imbestigasyon, natuklasan na sinakal ang biktima na siyang naging sanhi ng kanyang pagkamatay.
english: In the investigation, it was discovered that the victim was strangled which caused his death.

text: Sinugatan din ng suspek ang pulso ng biktima upang iligaw ang imbestigasyon ng pulisya at magmukhang walang foul play.
english: The suspect also stabbed the victim in the wrist to mislead the police investigation and make it look like there was no foul play.

text: Nang lumabas ang resulta ng autopsy, doon na at biglang nawla angtiyuhin na sa panahong iyon ay itinuturing na palang person of interest sa krimen.
english: When the result of the autopsy came out, there and suddenly disappeared angtiyuhin who at that time was considered a person of interest in the crime.

text: Kalaunan, sumuko ang suspek sa pulisya at inamin ang krimeng nagawa.
english: Later, the suspect surrendered to the police and confessed to the crime.

text: Inihahanda na ang kasong rape with homicide laban sa kanya.
english: A case of rape with homicide is being prepared against him.

text: Mayroon na ring dating rekord ang suspek sa pulisya dahil sa paglabag sa Republic Act 9262 o Anti-Violence Against Women and Their Children Act of 2004 noong Agosto 2025.
english: The suspect also has a previous record with the police for violating Republic Act 9262 or Anti-Violence Against Women and Their Children Act of 2004 in August 2025.

text:
***

Sa aton Konstitusyon, nagakilala kita sa kagamhanan sang Diyos, ang
nagaisahanon nga tag-iya sang tanan sa kalibutan.
english:
***

In our Constitution, we recognize the sovereignty of God, the
sole owner of everything in the world.

text:
Tungod sini, ang kinamatarong naton nga mga tawo amo gid lang ang
bilang“steward”, ukon tulugyanan lang kag manugtatap sang propiedad sang Diyos.
english:
Therefore, the rights of us humans are the only
as a “steward”, or just a steward and caretaker of God's property.

text:
Tungod man sini, kag sa wala pinilian nga kaalwan sang Diyos nga tag-iya
sang tanan diri sa kalibutan,  may
obligasyon kita sa aton mga kasilingan para sa ila man masulhay kag wala sablag
nga pagsinalayo sa kon diin man may kinamatarong sila magpuyo.
english:
Because of this, and the impartial grace of God the owner
of all the people in the world, there is
we have an obligation to our neighbors for their comfort and safety
removal from wherever they have the right to live.

text:
Ang aton Konstitusyon (1987 Constitution), nga gin-aprubahan sang
Constitutional Convention kag ginpatuman ni anay President Cory Aquino,
nagakilala man gani sining obligasyon naton sa Diyos sa ginasugo sini nga
“common good”.
english:
Our Constitution (1987 Constitution), approved by
Constitutional Convention and implemented by former President Cory Aquino,
it also recognizes our obligation to God in this command to
“common good”.

text:
Ang Section 6, Article XII nagasiling: “The use of property bears a social
function and all economic economic agents shall contribute to the common good.”

Kag tungod ang  pribado nga
paghimakas (private intiative) ang nagapanguna nga economic activity sa aton
Demokrasya, ang estado indi dapat magpasilabot (interfere), luas lang kon ang
kaayuhan na sang pumuluyo – indibidwal man ukon katilingban – ang masablagan na
sing wala nagakabagay.
english:
Section 6, Article XII states: “The use of property bears a social
function and all economic economic agents shall contribute to the common good.”

And because the private
private initiative is the main economic activity in our country
Democracy, the state should not interfere, unless the
the welfare of the people – individual or society – is at stake
inappropriately.

text:
In fact, indi naman kinahanglan mag-interfere ang estado, kon kita mismo
nga mga pumuluyo nagakilala sining aton obligasyon sa “common good” nga ang
Diyos mismo luyag matabo.
english:
In fact, the state doesn't have to interfere, if we ourselves
citizens recognize this obligation to the “common good” that the
God himself wants to happen.

text:
Indi ta pag-itugot nga ang aton harianon kag indi Diyosnon nga batasan ang
madominar sa aton.
english:
Let us not allow our royal and ungodly behavior to
dominate us.

text:
Dapat nakamuklat na kita sa mga leksyon nga gintudlo sa aton
sang kasaysayan.
english:
We should be awake to the lessons that have been taught to us
of history.

text:
Katulad sang French Revoluton sang 1789, ang natabo sa Rusya, sa Tsina, sa

english:
Similar to the French Revoluton of 1789, what happened in Russia, in China, in

text: Nagluksa ang lungsod ng Lisbon, Portugal matapos masawi ang hindi bababa sa 15 katao at masugatan ang ilan pa sa isang malagim na aksidente ng isang funicular railway na kilala sa mga turista.
english: The city of Lisbon, Portugal is in mourning after at least 15 people were killed and several others injured in a serious accident on a funicular railway popular with tourists.

text: Kumpirmado mula sa mga awtoridad na hindi bababa sa 15 ang nasawi habang marami ang sugatan matapos madisgrasya ang Glória Funicular sa Lisbon nitong Miyerkules.
english: Authorities confirmed that at least 15 people were killed and many others injured after the Glória Funicular crashed in Lisbon on Wednesday.

text: Ilang pasahero ang naiulat na naipit pa sa loob ng bagon habang nagpapatuloy ang rescue operations.
english: Several passengers were reportedly trapped inside the wagon while rescue operations continued.

text: Sa inisyal na impormasyon mula sa Public Security Police, tatlo ang naiulat na nasawi at may mahigit dalawampung sugatan, kabilang ang siyam na nasa kritikal na kondisyon.
english: According to initial information from the Public Security Police, three people were reported killed and more than two injured, including nine in critical condition.

text: Kinagabihan, lumobo pa ang bilang ng mga biktima.
english: The next night, the number of victims rose.

text: Ayon kay Lisbon Mayor Carlos Moedas, ito ay isang napakabigat na araw para sa lungsod.
english: According to Lisbon Mayor Carlos Moedas, this is a very difficult day for the city.

text: Inilarawan niya ang insidente bilang isang matinding trahedya at sinabi na ang lahat ng yunit ng pamahalaang lungsod, kabilang ang mga emergency services, civil protection at fire department, ay nagtutulungan sa pagsagip at pagtugon sa mga biktima.
english: He described the incident as a severe tragedy and said all units of the city government, including the emergency services, civil protection and fire department, are working together to rescue and respond to the victims.

text: Dagdag niya, buong Lisbon ay nagluluksa.
english: He added that the whole of Lisbon is in mourning.

text: Ang Glória Funicular ay isang makasaysayang pampasaherong tren na binuksan pa noong 1885 at isa sa mga tanyag na atraksyong panturista ng lungsod.
english: The Glória Funicular is a historic passenger train that was opened in 1885 and is one of the city's most popular tourist attractions.

text: May kakayahan itong magsakay ng hanggang 42 katao.
english: It can carry up to 42 people.

text: Ayon sa mga video na ibinahagi ng mga nakasaksi sa social media, makikita ang makapal na usok sa lugar at ang kaguluhan sa paligid ng nadisgrasyang tren.
english: According to videos shared by witnesses on social media, thick smoke can be seen in the area and chaos around the crashed train.

text: Maraming pasahero ang nakita na lumalabas sa bintana ng isang bagon habang ang isa naman ay nakatagilid at wasak.
english: Several passengers were seen coming out of the window of one wagon while the other was overturned and broken.

text: Patuloy pa rin ang imbestigasyon sa sanhi ng pagkaderayl.
english: The cause of the derailment is still under investigation.

text: Kabilang sa mga tumitingin sa insidente ay ang Homicide Brigade ng Judiciary Police, na bahagi ng standard procedure sa mga ganitong aksidente.
english: Among those who looked into the incident was the Homicide Brigade of the Judiciary Police, which is part of standard procedure in such accidents.

text: Ayon sa Carris, ang kumpanyang nangangasiwa sa operasyon ng Glória Funicular, nakahanda at aktibo na ang lahat ng kanilang tauhan at kagamitan upang tumugon sa insidente.
english: According to Carris, the company in charge of the operation of Glória Funicular, all their personnel and equipment are ready and active to respond to the incident.

text: Tiniyak ng isang opisyal na kasalukuyang mino-monitor ang sitwasyon ngunit hindi pa nagbibigay ng karagdagang detalye kaugnay ng posibleng sanhi.
english: An official confirmed that the situation is currently being monitored but did not provide further details on the possible cause.

text: Sa isang opisyal na pahayag, ipinahayag ni Portuguese President Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa ang kanyang taos-pusong pakikiramay sa mga naulila at naapektuhan ng insidente.
english: In an official statement, Portuguese President Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa expressed his sincere condolences to the bereaved and affected by the incident.

text: Nilinaw ng abogado ng mga biktima ng drug war na maaaring i-waive ni dating Pangulong Rodrigo Duterte ang kanyang karapatang dumalo kapag nagsimula na ang confirmation of charges hearing sa International Criminal Court (ICC).
english: The lawyer of the victims of the drug war clarified that former President Rodrigo Duterte may waive his right to attend when the confirmation of charges hearing begins at the International Criminal Court (ICC).

text: Sa panayam ng Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Gilbert Andres, sinabi niya na sa ilalim ng Rome Statute, kinakailangang naroon ang suspek sa confirmation hearing, ngunit binibigyan din si Duterte ng opsyon kung ayaw niyang dumalo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Gilbert Andres, he said that under the Rome Statute, the suspect must be present at the confirmation hearing, but Duterte is also given the option if he does not want to attend.

text: Matatandaang sa pagbasa ng desisyon sa kanyang apela kaugnay sa pagbasura ng korte sa interim release noong Nobyembre 2025, ini-waive rin ni Duterte ang kanyang karapatang dumalo, pisikal man o virtual.
english: It can be recalled that in reading the decision on his appeal regarding the court's rejection of the interim release in November 2025, Duterte also waived his right to attend, whether physically or virtually.

text: Sa halip na si Duterte, ang tanging humarap noon ay ang kanyang abogado na si Nicholas Kaufman kasabay ng pagbasa ng desisyon ng Appeals Chamber.
english: Instead of Duterte, the only one who appeared was his lawyer Nicholas Kaufman during the reading of the decision of the Appeals Chamber.

text: Ayon pa kay Andres, sa pagsisimula ng apat na araw na proceedings sa Pebrero 23, posibleng tumagal ito ng humigit-kumulang tatlong oras bawat araw, kung saan bibigyan ng patas na pagkakataon ang defense at ang prosekusyon para sa opening at closing statements, mga legal at factual na argumento, at presentasyon ng mga references ng ebidensya.
english: According to Andres, with the start of the four-day proceedings on February 23, it is likely to last approximately three hours each day, where the defense and the prosecution will be given a fair opportunity for opening and closing statements, legal and factual arguments, and presentation of reference evidence.

text: Pahayag niya, matapos ang confirmation of charges hearing, may tatlong posibleng senaryo na siyang pag-confirm ng mga kaso, ang pagtangging i-confirm ang mga ito, o ang pag-adjourn at ibalik sa prosekusyon ang mga dokumentong naglalaman ng kaso.
english: He said that after the confirmation of charges hearing, he has three possible scenarios of confirming the cases, refusing to confirm them, or adjourning and returning the documents containing the case to the prosecution.

text: Dagdag pa niya, nahaharap si Duterte sa three counts ng murder bilang crimes against humanity, at kahit isang count lamang ang ma-confirm, magpapatuloy na ang kaso sa trial.
english: He added that Duterte is facing three counts of murder as crimes against humanity, and even if only one count is confirmed, the case will continue to trial.

text: Madamo sang sahi sang mannerism.
english: There are many types of mannerisms.

text: May yara sang nagakitkit sang ila nga kuko, may yara sang masami nga nagahikap sang ila nga dulunggan kag iban pa.
english: Some bite their nails, some often touch their ears and so on.

text: Ikaw ano ang imo mannerism?
english: You what is your mannerism?

text: Ngaa bala may yara sang mannerism?
english: Why is there a mannerism?

text: Suno kay Clarissa Mariano-Ligon, early childhood and family specialist, ang mannerism ang isa ka physical gesture, paghulag sang parte sang lawas ukon sa speech.
english: According to Clarissa Mariano-Ligon, early childhood and family specialist, mannerism is a physical gesture, movement of parts of the body or in speech.

text: Naga-form ang mannerism subconsciously ukon indi mo matalupangdan nga ginahimo mo na gali — Indi lang kaisa kundi masami, adlaw-adlaw kag liwat-liwat.
english: The mannerism forms subconsciously or you don’t notice that you’re actually doing it — Not just once but often, daily and over and over again.

text: “Self soothing” ukon nagahatag sang pagpakalma ang mannerism rason nga ginahimo ini sang tawo.
english: Mannerism is “self soothing” or provides calmness that is why people do it.

text: Kun ikaw nag nakulbaan ukon bored, dira kag nagaform man ang mannerism.
english: When you're nervous or bored, that's where mannerism forms.

text: Apang kun ang mannerism mo ang nagahatag na sang malain nga epekto sa imo pang adlaw-adlaw, dapat nga magpaidalom ka na sa habit reversal training.
english: But if your mannerism is already having a negative impact on your daily life, you should undergo habit reversal training.

text: Panugyan sang eksperto, pilion ang mannerism nga makabulig sa imo kaugalingon.
english: Expert advice, choose the mannerism that works best for you.

english: Japan will reopen the world's largest nuclear power plant next week.

text: Kumpleto man sila sa pagkaon, water bottles, toiletries, kag iban pa nga mga suplay.

text: Kumpyansa ang Department of Agriculture (DA) nga maganubo gid subong nga bulan ang presyo sang karne sang baboy.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) is confident that the price of pork will drop significantly this month.

text: Ginplastar sang spokesperson sang ahensya nga si Undersecretary Arnel V. de Mesa ang nagaayo nga produksyon kag ang pasalig sang industriya nga maga-us-os ang presyo sang produkto sa merkado.
english: Agency spokesperson Undersecretary Arnel V. de Mesa highlighted the improving production and the industry's assurance that the price of the product will fall in the market.

text: Suno sa opisyal, nagsugtanay ang pork producers, traders, kag retailers nga repasuhon ang ila nga cost structures antes ang pagpatuman sang maximum suggested retail price (MSRP).
english: According to the official, pork producers, traders, and retailers agreed to review their cost structures before the implementation of the maximum suggested retail price (MSRP).

text: Ginbalikan man ni De Mesa nga nagnubo na gani ang presyo sini sa P214 kada kilo halin sa P250-P260 sang nagligad nga Pebrero.
english: De Mesa also recalled that the price has even dropped to P214 per kilo from P250-P260 last February.

text: Ginpasalig naman sang Malacañang nga ang kasim (shoulder) kag ang pigue (leg) mahimo man magnubo sa P350 tubtub sa P360 per kilo sa Marso 10, sandig sa update nga ginhatag ni Agriculture Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel, Jr.
english: Malacañang assured that kasim (shoulder) and pigue (leg) could also be reduced to P350 to P360 per kilo on March 10, based on an update provided by Agriculture Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel, Jr.

text: Base pa sa tiglikom, ginalauman nga ang liempo (belly) magatupa sa P380 per kilo.
english: According to the secretary, liempo (belly) is expected to fall to P380 per kilo.

text: Una na ginsiling nga amat-amat lang ang pag-implementar sang MSRP nga ginalantaw maga-umpisa sa Marso 10.
english: Earlier, it was said that the implementation of the MSRP will be gradual and is expected to start on March 10.

text: Base man sa report sang Philippine Statistics Authority, ang karne sang baboy amo ang highest contributor sa inflation rate sang Pebrero nga nagtupa sa 2.1%.
english: Based on the report of the Philippine Statistics Authority, pork was the highest contributor to the inflation rate in February which fell to 2.1%.

text: Napuhag man sang bomb threat ang West Visayas State University (WVSU) Calinog Campus subong nga aga.
english: The West Visayas State University (WVSU) Calinog Campus was also rocked by a bomb threat this morning.

text:

Magluwas diri, gin-suspend man ang trabaho para sa tanan nga staff kag administrative personnel.
english:

english: Everyone is advised to stay alert and remain safe,” the university said in a statement.

text: Ini na ang ikatatlo nga campus sang WVSU nga ginpadal-an sang mensahe nga may bomba.

text: Sang nagligad nga semana, may bomb threat man sa Janiuay campus, kag subong gid lamang nga aga, gin-suspend man ang klase sa main campus sa La Paz, Iloilo City bangud sa nabaton nga kaangay man nga pamahog.
english: Last week, there was a bomb threat at the Janiuay campus, and this morning, classes at the main campus in La Paz, Iloilo City were also suspended due to a similar threat.

text:
Gindayon sang OPM icon nga si Gary Valenciano ang “Pure Energy: One More Time” concert kagab-i, Disyembre 22, sa Smart Araneta Coliseum matapos nga naglain ang iya pamatyag kag napaslawan nga mapatapos ang nauna nga konsyerto sang Biyernes sang gab-i.

Lakip sa nangin kaupod sang Filipino singer sa iya pagbalik sa entablado amo ang SB19, si Darren Espanto, si AC Bonifacio, kag si Gloc-9 nga nag-perform sang award-winning song nga ‘Walang Pumapalakpak’.
english:
OPM icon Gary Valenciano attended the “Pure Energy: One More Time” concert last night, December 22, at the Smart Araneta Coliseum after he felt unwell and failed to finish the previous concert on Friday night.

Among those who joined the Filipino singer in his return to the stage were SB19, Darren Espanto, AC Bonifacio, and Gloc-9 who performed the award-winning song 'Walang Pumapalakpak'.

text: Yara man mismo ang anak ni Gary nga si Kiana Valenciano-Tolentino.

text:

Una na nga nagpasalamat ang Team Gary V sa mga nagpangamuyo para sa iya ikaayong lawas kag nagpangayo man sang pasaylo sa natabo sang Biyernes.

Despite all this, he continues to be known as “Mr. Pure Energy.”

text:
KITA nga mga Filipino kilala sa paghatag sing daku nga importansya
sa pamilya.
english:
WE Filipinos are known for giving great importance
in the family.

text:
Para sa aton, ang pamilya nagasakop indi lang sang ginikanan,
mag-ululutod kag mga kabataan sa 1st degree nga relasyon sunu sa kasuguan.
english:
For us, family encompasses not only parents,
siblings and children in 1st degree relationships according to the law.

text:
Sakop man sini ang yara sa 2nd degree nga relasyon kanday lolo kag
lola, apo, tiya, tiyo, hinablos, kag mga anak sang isa sang mga ginikanan
(half-siblings).
english:
It also covers the 2nd degree relationship between grandparents and
grandmother, grandchildren, aunts, uncles, nieces, nephews, and children of one of the parents
(half-siblings).

text:
Kalakip man diri ang 3rd degree nga relasyon sa mga
pakaisa (first cousins), eloy kag elay (grandparents) kag mga apo sa tuhod
(great grandchildren).
english:
This also includes 3rd degree relationships with
first cousins, eloy and elay (grandparents) and great-grandchildren
(great grandchildren).

text:
In fact, sa amon pamilya sa panahon ni lolo kag lola ko tubtub
subong, dapat suod gihapon ang aton relasyon sa mga pakaduha kag pakatatlo.
english:
In fact, in our family from the time of my grandparents until
now, we should still have a close relationship with the second and third.

text:
Amo
gani nga ginadumili gihapon sang amon katigulangan ang makig-nobya ukon
makig-nobyo sa bisan pakaduha ukon pakatlo namon.
english:
No
so that our ancestors still forbid dating or
date for either the second or third time.

text:
Ang ining pagkalapit sang relasyon daku nga rason kon ngaa ang mga
Filipino madale makabangon sa tion sang kalamidad ukon sa ano man nga problema
sa pangabuhi.
english:
This closeness of relationship is a big reason why the
Filipinos are quick to rise in times of disaster or any problem
in life.

text:
Madamo ka madalaganan sing bulig, dugang pa kay ang aton gobyerno
may bukas man nga palad sa pagbulig sa mga pumuluyo sa tion sang kalamidad.
english:
You can turn to many people for help, plus our government
there is also an open hand in helping the people in times of disaster.

text:
Mabudlay tumbahon matuod ang Filipino sa ano man nga trahedya
tungod sining kilala nga pagbinuligay kag pag-unongay.
english:
It is difficult to knock down the Filipino in any tragedy
because of this well-known cooperation and solidarity.

text:
Ugaling lang, ang kapigaduhon kon kis-a may indi malikawan
(inevitable) nga mga hitabo, nga bisan ang kabalaslan naton sa aton
katigulangan indi ta na mabalik sa ila sing nagakaigu sa wala pahuway sadto nga
pagtatap sa aton kag pag-antos halin sa pagdala sang aton iloy kag pagbun-ag
tubtub mangin hamtong kag lubos na makatindug sa aton kaugalingon.
english:
However, poverty sometimes has an inevitable
(inevitable) events, that even our reward for our
ancestors we cannot return to them properly in that restless
taking care of us and suffering from carrying our mother and giving birth
until we are mature and fully able to stand on our own.

text:
Yara ang problema sa pag-ubay sa ila kon maluya na, ang paghatag
sang maayo nga pagkaon, kag padayon nga pagsuporta sa ila pagbalatian agud
mapabatyag ang aton pagpalangga sa ila kag handom nga makita sila nga malipayon
tubtub sa ulihi nga tinion sang ila kabuhi.
english:
There’s the problem of keeping up with them once weak, giving
of good nutrition, and continued support in their illness to
make them feel our love and desire to see them happy
until the last moment of their lives.

text:
Kon kis-a ugaling mapabay-an ta sila kay magwa pa kita agud
mangita sang kinawala kag indi man mahatag ang ila tanan nga kinahanglanon sa
diutay man naton nga kinitaan.
english:
Sometimes we let them go because we have to go out to
seek nothing and cannot provide for all their needs in
we also earn little.

text:
Kon kis-a man, patawaron kita sang Diyos, kay sa aton kaburido sa
pangabuhi masakit pa naton sila, lokohon sa ila diutay nga nasuptan, kag
mahabuyan pa sing indi maayo nga sugilanon sa ila pagpasaway sa pagbinata-bata
na nila nga binatasan.
english:
Sometimes, God will forgive us, because of our sin in
we can hurt them, cheat them of their little possessions, and
they will throw a bad story about their childish discipline
that's their habit.

text:
Masakit man isipon ugaling nga kon kis-a i-surrender pa naton ang
pagtatap sa ila sa DSWD nga kulang man sing pondo kag sa mga pribado nga Home
for the Aged, nga indi man makatatap sing husto sa mga ginapalapit sa ila
tungod sa kakulang man nila sing pondo halin sa wala seguro nga mga donasyon.
english:
It hurts to think that sometimes we surrender the
taking care of them in the DSWD which also lacks funds and in private Homes

text:
Ini na lang bala ang dapat madangtan sang aton mga katigulangan
tungod sa kapigaduhon kag pagpatumbaya sa ila, sa hungod man ukon indi?
english:
Is this all our ancestors deserve
because of their poverty and neglect, intentionally or unintentionally?

text:
Wala na
bala mahimo ang aton gobyerno para matatapan sila sing maayo kon ang ila mga
pamilya ga-surrender na sa pagtatap sa ila?
english:
Gone
can our government do anything to take good care of them when their

text:
Tandaan naton nga daku gid ang pagpalangga sang Diyos sa mga
kabataan kag sa mga tigulang.
english:
Let us remember that God loves those who
children and the elderly.

text:
“Honor thy father and mother”, siling gani sang Diyos sa iya
Ikaapat nga Sugo, nga nagapatunda sang aton obligasyon sa ila labi na gid sa
ila pagtigulang kon san-o kinahanglan gid ang aton pagtatap sa ila.
english:
“Honor thy father and mother”, God said to him

text:
Ginsiling pa gani ni Moses nga: “Whoever curses father or mother

english:
Moses even said that: “Whoever curses father or mother

them.

text:
Si Hesukristo gani nagpahibalo man kon ano ang pagpalangga sang
Diyos sa aton tigulang na nga mga ginikanan.
english:
Jesus Christ even revealed what love is
God bless our elderly parents.

text:
Sa kasuguan sang mga Hudeo ginadid-an bawion ang sinumpaan nga
halad (corban) sa Diyos, bisan pa sa luyag sang anak nga bawion ini agud ibulig
