Sunu ugaling kay Kristo, indi ini nga tradisyon santu sa kasuguan

Sa aton pa, di bale na ang halad sa Diyos basta mabuligan lang

english:
According to Christ, however, this tradition is not according to the law
of God because “The Law is given by God not for its own sake but for the good
of men and women.”

In other words, the sacrifice to God is nothing as long as it is helped
we should respect our parents especially in their need for them
old age.

text:
Kasubong man bala sini ang pagpalangga sang aton gobyerno kag
Simbahan sa aton katigulangan?

text: Apisar 37-anyos na ang edad, wala ginadula sang Serbian ang posibilidad nga magbalik pa gid sa masunod nga tuig para sa grand slam tournament.
english: Despite being 37-years-old, the Serbian does not rule out the possibility of returning next year for the grand slam tournament.

text: Ang pag-withdraw ni Djokovic nagkahulugan nga awtomatiko na nga nag-abanse si Zverev sa iya una nga career finals sa Australian Open kun sa diin maatubang sini si world number 1 Jannik Sinner.
english: Djokovic's withdrawal meant Zverev automatically advanced to his first career finals at the Australian Open where he will face world number 1 Jannik Sinner.

text: Pinagtibay ng Pilipinas at India ang ugnayan sa turismo sa ASEAN sa pamamagitan ng mas malakas at direktang koneksyon.
english: The Philippines and India have strengthened tourism ties with ASEAN through stronger and more direct connections.

text: Ayon kay Tourism Secretary Christina Garcia-Frasco, ang visa-free entry para sa mga Indian at ang paglulunsad ng direktang flights ay nagresulta sa pagtaas ng bilang ng Indian visitor arrivals sa bansa.
english: According to Tourism Secretary Christina Garcia-Frasco, the visa-free entry for Indians and the launch of direct flights have resulted in an increase in the number of Indian visitor arrivals in the country.

text: Binanggit niya na kapag bukas ang mga pintuan at may maayos na koneksyon, nakikinabang ang komunidad sa mas maraming oportunidad at kabuhayan.
english: He mentioned that when the doors are open and there is good connectivity, the community benefits from more opportunities and livelihoods.

text: Sa pulong ng 13th ASEAN-India Tourism Ministers, tinalakay ang sustainable tourism, capacity building, at pagbibigay ng mataas na kalidad na karanasan sa turista.
english: During the 13th ASEAN-India Tourism Ministers' meeting, sustainable tourism, capacity building, and providing high-quality tourist experiences were discussed.

text: Ayon sa datos, milyun-milyong Indian at ASEAN travelers ang naglakbay sa rehiyon, na nagpapatunay sa lumalakas na tourism ecosystem sa parehong panig.
english: According to data, millions of Indian and ASEAN travelers have traveled to the region, proving the growing tourism ecosystem on both sides.

text: Malipayon ang aktor nga si Cesar Montano para sa iya anay asawa nga si Sunshine Cruz nga subong kumpirmado na nga karelasyon sang gambling tycoon nga si Atong Ang.
english: Actor Cesar Montano is happy for his ex-wife Sunshine Cruz who is now confirmed to be dating gambling tycoon Atong Ang.

text: Suno kay Cesar, kun malipayon si Sunshine, buot silingon sini, malipayon man ang ila mga anak — kag bilang amay, kalipayan man niya ini.
english: According to Cesar, if Sunshine is happy, it means that their children are happy — and as a father, it is his joy.

text: Nagpahayag man ini nga saludo siya kay Atong sa iya kaisog sa pag-ako sa iya relasyon kay Sunshine.
english: He also said he salutes Atong for his courage in admitting his relationship with Sunshine.

text: “Saludo ako kay Atong for being man enough to admit his relationship with Shine.
english: “I salute Atong for being man enough to admit his relationship with Shine.

text: I sincerely wish that they will live happily ever after.
english: I sincerely wish that they will live happily ever after.

text: They both deserve to be happy.
english: They both deserve to be happy.

text: When Shine is happy, that means our three daughters are happy, too.
english: When Shine is happy, that means our three daughters are happy, too.

text: And as a father, my daughters’ happiness is mine as well,” suno sa 62-anyos nga actor.
english: And as a father, my daughters’ happiness is mine as well,” the 62-year-old actor said.

text: Nahibaluan nga 2018 sang gin-annul ang kasal nanday Cesar kag Sunshine, kag subong mag-abyan gihapon sila kag makit-an nga naga-upod sa pila ka mga okasyon nga kinahanglan sila sang ila mga bata nga sanday Angelina, Chesca, kag Sam.
english: It is known that Cesar and Sunshine had their marriage annulled in 2018, and now they are still friends and can be seen together on several occasions when their children Angelina, Chesca, and Sam need them.

text: Sini man nga semana sang nakumpirma ang relasyon nanday Atong kag Sunshine matapos nga naglapta ang videos sang ila paghalukanay.
english: This week, Atong and Sunshine's relationship was confirmed after videos of them kissing went viral.

text: Antes sini, may anum ka tuig man nga relasyon si Shine sa pulitiko nga si Macky Mathay apang gin-anunsyo ang ila pagbulagay sang Septyembre 2022.
english: Before that, Shine was also in a six-year relationship with politician Macky Mathay but announced their split in September 2022.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, na-link man anay si Atong sa aktres nga si Gretchen Barretto apang ginpahayag anay ni Gretchen nga mag-business partner lamang sila.
english: On the other hand, Atong was also linked to actress Gretchen Barretto but Gretchen said they were just business partners.

text: Naging sentro ng regional tourism ang Cebu nang maging host ng 45th ASEAN Tourism Forum (ATF) 2026 mula Enero 26 hanggang 30, na dinaluhan ng tinatayang 5,000 delegado mula sa ASEAN member states at dialogue partners tulad ng China, Japan, South Korea, India, at Russia.
english: Cebu became a center of regional tourism when it hosted the 45th ASEAN Tourism Forum (ATF) 2026 from January 26 to 30, which was attended by an estimated 5,000 delegates from ASEAN member states and dialogue partners such as China, Japan, South Korea, India, and Russia.

text: Sa temang “Navigating Our Tourism Future, Together,” nagtipon ang mga tourism ministers, senior officials, at industry leaders para sa high-level policy discussions at Travex trade exchanges na naglalayong palakasin ang ASEAN bilang isang pinagsamang global tourism destination.
english: Under the theme “Navigating Our Tourism Future, Together,” tourism ministers, senior officials, and industry leaders gathered for high-level policy discussions at Travex trade exchanges that seek to strengthen ASEAN as an integrated global tourism destination.

text: Higit pa sa mga pulong, naranasan ng mga delegado ang mayamang kultura at kasaysayan ng Cebu sa pamamagitan ng aktibidad na “Paglantaw: A Heritage Tour of Old Cebu”, na dinaluhan ang mga landmark tulad ng Magellan’s Cross, Basilica Minore del Santo Niño, at Fort San Pedro.
english: More than words, the delegates experienced the rich culture and history of Cebu through the activity “Paglantaw: A Heritage Tour of Old Cebu”, which visited landmarks such as Magellan's Cross, Basilica Minore del Santo Niño, and Fort San Pedro.

text: Kasabay ng ATF, host din ang Cebu ng ASEAN Foreign Ministers’ Retreat at ang 48th ASEAN Plus Three NTOs Meeting, na nagpapatibay ng kooperasyon sa China, Japan, at South Korea.
english: Along with the ATF, Cebu is also hosting the ASEAN Foreign Ministers’ Retreat and the 48th ASEAN Plus Three NTOs Meeting, which strengthens cooperation with China, Japan, and South Korea.

text: Sa pagtatapos ng ATF 2026, inanunsyo na Singapore ang susunod na host ng forum sa Enero 2027, na nagpapatuloy ng taunang rotation ng mga miyembrong bansa.
english: At the end of ATF 2026, Singapore announced the next host of the forum in January 2027, continuing the annual rotation of member countries.

text: Ayon sa mga opisyal, ang matagumpay na forum ngayong taon ay nagpapatunay sa pangako ng ASEAN sa sustainable tourism at ipinakita ang Pilipinas bilang premier host para sa malalaking international events.
english: According to officials, this year's successful forum proves ASEAN's commitment to sustainable tourism and showcased the Philippines as a premier host for major international events.

text: Maga-atubang ang Gilas Pilipinas sa tatlo ka national teams bilang preparasyon sa third and final window sang FIBA 2025 Asia Cup qualifiers sa Pebrero.
english: Gilas Pilipinas will face three national teams in preparation for the third and final window of the FIBA ​​2025 Asia Cup qualifiers in February.

text: Ang makasumpong sang Gilas amo ang Qatar, Lebanon kag Egypt sa 2nd Doha Invitational Cup nga amo ang four-nation friendly tournament nga gin-organisa sang Qatar Basketball Federation.
english: The Gilas will face Qatar, Lebanon and Egypt in the 2nd Doha Invitational Cup which is a four-nation friendly tournament organized by the Qatar Basketball Federation.

text: Matabo ini sa Qatar University sa Pebrero 14-16.
english: It will take place at Qatar University on February 14-16.

text: Una nga makasumpong sang Gilas ang host country sa imbukada sang tournament, pagasundan sang Lebanon, kag Egypt sa katapusan nga adlaw.
english: The Gilas will face the host country first in the tournament opener, followed by Lebanon and Egypt on the final day.

text: Sa Pebrero 13 magahalin si Coach Tim Cone kag ang national team kaupod si Troy Rosario nga amo ang pinakaulihi nga gindugang sa lineup matapos nakaangkon sang injuries sanday Kai Sotto kag Kevin Quiambao.
english: On February 13, Coach Tim Cone and the national team will leave with Troy Rosario, the latest addition to the lineup after Kai Sotto and Kevin Quiambao sustained injuries.

text: Yara man ang naturalized player nga si Ange Kouame bangud mangin absent sa training camp ang veteran big man nga si Japeth Aguilar.
english: Naturalized player Ange Kouame will also be available as veteran big man Japeth Aguilar will be absent from training camp.

text: Lauman nga magaupod man sa duha ang mainstays sang team nga sanday Justin Brownlee, Scottie Thompson, June Mar Fajardo, CJ Perez, Dwight Ramos, Carl Tamayo, Chris Newsome, Calvin Oftana, Mason Amos, kag ang nagbalik nga sanday AJ Edu kag Jamie Malonzo.
english: Team mainstays Justin Brownlee, Scottie Thompson, June Mar Fajardo, CJ Perez, Dwight Ramos, Carl Tamayo, Chris Newsome, Calvin Oftana, Mason Amos, and returnees AJ Edu and Jamie Malonzo are also expected to join the duo.

text: Ini nga friendly games ang magapreparar sa Pilipinas sa posible pagbalos sang Chinese Taipei kag New Zealand sa ila pagkitaay sa masunod nga bulan.
english: These friendly games will prepare the Philippines for a possible retaliation between Chinese Taipei and New Zealand when they meet next month.

text: Nahibaluan nga undefeated ang Gilas, 4-0, sa Group B kag antes pa man ang final window, pormal na ini nga naka-qualify para sa FIBA Asia Cup 2025 sa Saudi Arabia.#
english: The Gilas are undefeated, 4-0, in Group B and before the final window, they have formally qualified for the FIBA ​​Asia Cup 2025 in Saudi Arabia.

text: Linibo nga tawo ang nagtambong sa pinakadako nga mosque sa Sanaa, Yemen para sa lubong sang 12 ka mga mataas nga opisyal sang Houthi lakip na ang ila Prime Minister nga napatay sa Israeli airstrike.
english: Thousands of people turned out at the largest mosque in Sanaa, Yemen for the funeral of 12 senior Houthi officials including their Prime Minister killed in an Israeli airstrike.

text: Natabo ang pag-atake sang nagligad nga seman sa diin madamo nga tawo ang nagtipon agud maglantaw kuntani sang televised speech sang top Houthi leader nga si Abdul Malik al-Houthi.
english: The attack took place last week when many people gathered to watch a televised speech by top Houthi leader Abdul Malik al-Houthi.

text: Kadam-an sa mga myembro sang gabinete sang grupo ang napatay sa amo nga insidente.
english: Most of the group's cabinet members were killed in the incident.

text: Santang ginapatigayon ang lubong sa Al Saleh Mosque, nagasinggitan ang mga tawo sang Houthi slogan nga “God is Great, Death to America, Death to Israel, Curse on the Jews, Victory to Islam.”
english: As the funeral was being held at the Al Saleh Mosque, people chanted the Houthi slogan “God is Great, Death to America, Death to Israel, Curse on the Jews, Victory to Islam.”

text: Nagalalain ang mag-asawa sa Pennsylvania sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika matapos nangindulaan ang ila bag-o gid lamang na-withdraw nga kuwarta nga sang ulihi natukiban nga ginpang-kaon gali sang ila nga ido!
english: A couple in Pennsylvania in the United States of America is in trouble after losing their newly withdrawn money which was later discovered to have been eaten by their dog!

text: Ang suspek sa amo nga insidente amo ang pito ka tuig nga ido nga si Cecil, isa ka Goldendoodle nga masami naga-behave gid suno sa iya mga tag-iya nga sanday Clayton kag Carrie Law.
english: The suspect in that incident was seven-year-old dog Cecil, a Goldendoodle who often behaved very well, according to his owners Clayton and Carrie Law.

text: Apang nagbag-o ang tanan sang isa ka adlaw, ginbutang sang duha ang ila $4,000 ukon P222,000 nga cash sa kusina nga bag-o gid lamang nakuha halin sa ila nga joint savings account.
english: But everything changed one day, the two put their $4,000 or P222,000 cash in the kitchen that had just been withdrawn from their joint savings account.

text: 30 minutos ang makaligad, indi na halos makahibalo ang duha sa ila nga himuon bangud gisi na ang tanan nga kuwarta bangud ginpang-gus-ab ini sang ila nga ido.
english: 30 minutes later, the two of them almost didn't know what to do because all the money was torn because their dog had chewed it.

english: “Cecil’s a goofy guy and he’s very particular — you could leave a steak on the table, and he wouldn’t touch it because he’s not food motivated,” according to Carrie, 33.

english: The couple also seemed relieved because the bank said the money could be exchanged if the serial numbers on the bills were also visible.

english: All the useful bills as well as the papers that had been removed from the vomit and dog feces were also quickly collected.

text: Sang ulihi, lab-ot lamang sa $450 (P25,000) ang nadula sa couple bangud indi na gid ini mapuslan, samtang may nabilin naman sa ila nga $3,550 (197,000).
english: In the end, the couple lost only $450 (P25,000) because it was no longer useful, while they were left with $3,550 (197,000).

english: “Welcome to the world, Calia Elle (baby Ninja)!

text: My life will never be the same.
english: My life will never be the same.

text: You are my greatest blessing,” caption sini sa iya nga Instagram post.
english: You are my greatest blessing,” she captioned her Instagram post.

text: Sang nagligad nga semana sang ginkumpirma sang transman nga nagbun-ag na siya.
english: It was last week when the transman confirmed she had given birth.

text: Matandaan nga sang Oktubre, ginpakigbahin sini ang balita sang iya pagbusong paagi sa pagpakita sang iya baby bump kag may rainbow flag sa iya abaga nga amo ang simbolo sang LGBTQIA+ community.
english: It can be recalled that in October, she shared the news of her pregnancy by showing off her baby bump and with a rainbow flag on her shoulder which is a symbol of the LGBTQIA+ community.

text: Pahayag sini, 2018 pa lang, nagplano na siya nga makaangkon sang anak apang wala natigayon bangud kulang sa kuwarta kag mataas gid ang galastuhan sa in vitro fertilization (IVF).
english: She said that in 2018, she planned to have a child but could not because of lack of money and the high cost of in vitro fertilization (IVF).

text: “Sa lahat ng gagawan ko ng caption, ito na yata ‘yung pinaka-nahirapan ako.
english: “Of all the captions I do, this is probably the most difficult for me.

text: Alam ko mahihirapan din kayong intindihin kung paano ito nangyari.
english: I know you will also have a hard time understanding how this happened.

text: 2018 nung simulan kong planuhing magkaroon ng anak.
english: 2018 when I started planning to have a baby.

text: Pero that time, maraming struggles, lalo na financially and hindi rin naman biro ang gastos sa unang plano kong mag-IVF,” pahayag anay sang former housemate sa PBB.
english: But that time, there were many struggles, especially financially and the cost of my first plan to do IVF was not a joke,” the former housemate told PBB.

text: Nagbalik ang iya partner sa iya kabuhi, kag bilang ‘father figure’ sa kabataan sang iya partner, gusto man sini nga makaangkon sang iya kaugalingon gid nga baby.
english: His partner came back into his life, and as a father figure to his partner's children, he also wanted to have his own baby.

text: “Hanggang sa bumalik sa buhay ko si Cams pati ang mga bata.
english: “Until Cams came back into my life and the kids.

text: Naisip kong parang sign na yata ito ni Lord sa’kin.
english: I thought it was a sign from the Lord to me.

text: Baka ito ‘yung warm-up Niya para sa’kin kung paano ako magiging magulang soon.
english: Maybe this is His warm-up for me on how I will be a parent soon.

text: Sa pagtayo ko bilang tatay ng mga anak ni Cams, maraming naging realizations.
english: As the father of Cams' children, I have had many realizations.

text: Isa na dun ‘yung baka may chance pa pala akong magkaroon ng sarili kong anak,” dugang sini.
english: One of them is that maybe I have a chance to have my own child,” he added.

text: “Fast forward ngayong taon, di ko in-expect na mabubuo siya through my last option na ako ang magdadala pero sobrang thankful ako na pinagkaloob ito ng Diyos sa akin.
english: “Fast forward to this year, I didn't expect him to be formed through my last option that I would carry but I'm so thankful that God gave it to me.

text: Hindi naging madali ang prosesong ito para sa akin kaya sana hindi niyo rin ganun kadaling husgahan kung anong nakikita niyo ngayon,” kabahin pa sang iya malawig nga caption.
english: This process has not been easy for me so I hope you don't judge what you see now,” he said in a long caption.

text: Sang amo man nga tion, nagpasalig ini nga suportahan gid sini gihapon ang kabataan sang iya partner kag palanggaon gid ang iya kaugalingon nga bata.
english: At the same time, she assured that she would still support her partner's children and love her own child.

text: “Simple lang naman ang gusto ko, ‘yung magkaroon ng matatawag kong sariling akin.
english: “I just want something simple, to have something I can call my own.

text: Alam kong may mga anak akong inako kay Cams at walang mababago dun sa pagdating ni “Ninja” (nickname ng baby ko Hahaha).
english: I know I have children with Cams and nothing will change with the arrival of “Ninja” (my baby's nickname Hahaha).

text:
Sa lahat ng desisyon ko sa buhay, malaki ang naging parte ng mga bata at ni Cams sa kung ano ako ngayon.”

“Samahan n’yo kami sa bagong journey ng buhay kong ito.
english:
In all my decisions in life, the kids and Cams have played a big part in what I am today.”

“Join us in this new journey of my life.

text: At sana kapulutan ng aral at inspirasyon ng marami,” dugang sini.
english: And hopefully it will be a lesson and inspiration to many,” he added.

text: Kabahin si Jesi sang Philippine television reality competition show sang 2006 nga StarStruck kag ka-batch sini sanday Kris Bernal, Aljur Abrenica, Chariz Solomon, kag iban pa.
english: Jesi was part of the Philippine television reality competition show in 2006 StarStruck and was in her batch with Kris Bernal, Aljur Abrenica, Chariz Solomon, and others.

text: Nangin housemate naman siya sang “Pinoy Big Brother” sang 2017 nga may moniker nga “Trans man of the House ng Cavite.”#
english: He became a housemate of “Pinoy Big Brother” in 2017 under the moniker “Trans man of the House ng Cavite.”#

text: Gin-veto ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. vetoed the bill.

text: ang ginduso nga hagna nga nagatuyo sa pagtukod kag pagpasangkad sang Philippine National Games (PNG).
english: the proposed bill aimed at the establishment and expansion of the Philippine National Games (PNG).

text: Santo sa veto message sang presidente nga ginpadala sa Kongreso, nagapati siya nga ang pag-establisar sang amo nga national sports program ang magahatag sang madamo nga benepisyo sa pungsod partikular na ang pag-establisar sang team sang national athletes.
english: According to the president's veto message sent to Congress, he believes that the establishment of the national sports program will bring many benefits to the country particularly the establishment of a team of national athletes.

text: Apang dugang niya, paagi sa ginduso nga hagna, maga-duplicate ang paninguha kag ang pondo para sa national sports program sa baylo nga makahatag sang dugang nga benepisyo.
english: However, he added that the proposed bill would duplicate efforts and funding for the national sports program instead of providing additional benefits.

text: Ginplastar sini ang Republic Act 10588 ukon ang Palarong Pambansa Act of 2013 nga nagatuyo sa pag-promote sang physical education kag paghaylo sa sports programs kag mga kumpetisyon lakip na ang paghanas para sa international events samtang nga ginatun-an ang disiplina, kaalam, kag importansya sang teamwork.
english: It enacted Republic Act 10588 or the Palarong Pambansa Act of 2013 which aims to promote physical education and encourage sports programs and competitions including training for international events while learning discipline, wisdom, and the importance of teamwork.

text: Dugang ni Marcos, ang probisyon sang hagna nga magtuko sang PNG Board bilang isa ka policy-making and coordinating body bilang preparasyon sa PNG ang naga-anggid na sa Section 8 sang RA 10588 nga amo naman ang nagatukod sa Palarong Pambansa Board bilang lead policy-making and coordinating body para sa preparasyon sa Palarong Pambansa.
english: Marcos added that the provision of the bill to establish the PNG Board as a policy-making and coordinating body in preparation for PNG is similar to Section 8 of RA 10588 which establishes the Palarong Pambansa Board as the lead policy-making and coordinating body for the preparation of the Palarong Pambansa.

text: Bangud sini nga mga rason suno kay Marcos, nagapati siya nga kun may tukuron pa gid nga PNG, may matabo nga functional duplication, leadership confusion, kag inefficiency.
english: For these reasons, Marcos said he believes that if there is another PNG, there will be functional duplication, leadership confusion, and inefficiency.

text: Dugang sang chief executive, ang ginaduso nga P1 million appropriation sa PNG ang inconsistent sa legislative function sang budget authorization process paagi sa enactment sang appropriation.
english: The chief executive added that the proposed P1 million appropriation in PNG is inconsistent with the legislative function of the budget authorization process through the enactment of appropriation.

text: “As a policy, the funding of programs and projects, such as national sports programs , should be subject to the usual budgeting process and congressional authorization, which take into account the availability of resources, estimated funding requirements vis-a-vis expected output, sustainability, and budgetary priorities,” dugang sini.
english: “As a policy, the funding of programs and projects, such as national sports programs , should be subject to the usual budgeting process and congressional authorization, which take into account the availability of resources, estimated funding requirements vis-a-vis expected output, sustainability, and budgetary priorities,” it added.

text: “As such, pursuant to Section 27(1), Article 6 of the 1987 Constitution, I am constrained to veto the enrolled Senate Bill No.
english: “As such, pursuant to Section 27(1), Article 6 of the 1987 Constitution, I am constrained to veto the enrolled Senate Bill No.

text: 2514/House Bill No.
english: 2514/House Bill No.

text: 8468, titled An Act Expanding and Institutionalizing PNG and Appropriating Funds Therefore,” kabahin pa sang iya nga veto message.
english: 8468, titled An Act Expanding and Institutionalizing PNG and Appropriating Funds Therefore,” part of his veto message.

text: Nag-abot na sa China si North Korea leader Kim Jong Un.
english: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has arrived in China.

text: Kaupod sini ang iya anak nga babayi nga si Kim Jue Ae ang ginapahayag nga magatal-os sa iya pwesto.
english: Along with him, his daughter Kim Jue Ae is said to succeed him.

text: Yara sa China si Kim para magtambong sa Victory Day parade sa pag-80 nga tuig sang pagtapos sang Word War 2.
english: Kim is in China to attend the Victory Day parade to mark the 80th anniversary of the end of Word War 2.

text: Nakaupod man niya sa pagtambong ang pila ka mga world leader kaangay nanday Russian President Vladimir Putin, mga lider sang Iran, Myanmar, kag Cuba.
english: He also attended with several world leaders such as Russian President Vladimir Putin, leaders of Iran, Myanmar, and Cuba.

text: Ulihi nga nagbisita si Kim sang 2019 kadungan sang ika-70 nga anibersaryo sang diplomatic ties sang duha ka pungsod.
english: Kim last visited in 2019 to coincide with the 70th anniversary of diplomatic ties between the two countries.

text: Milagro nga nahatagan liwat sang ikaduha nga tyansa nga mabuhi ang isa ka lalaki matapos anum ka adlaw nga na-trap sa iya salakyan nga nahulog sa idalom sang taytay.
english: A man was miraculously given a second chance to live after six days of being trapped in his car that fell under a bridge.

text: Natabo ini kay Matthew Reum, 27, residente sang Mishawaka, Indiana sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: This happened to Matthew Reum, 27, resident of Mishawaka, Indiana in the United States of America.

text: Sang Disyembre 20, samtang nagamaneho si Reum, wala sini na-kontrol ang iya pick-up kag nahulog gid sa pil-as, nagligid sang pila ka beses, kag halos wasak na sang nagtupa sa idalom sang taytay.
english: On Dec. 20, while Reum was driving, he lost control of his pick-up and fell completely off a cliff, rolled several times, and was almost destroyed when he landed under a bridge.

text: Nakaposisyon ang pickup sa area nga indi ini madasig nga ma-notisyaran rason nga bisan ano ka singgit ni Reum, wala gid sang nakabulig sa iya.
english: The pickup was positioned in an area where it could not be quickly noticed so no matter how much Reum shouted, no one helped her.

text: Halos madulaan na ini sang paglaum bangud indi man niya malab-ot ang iya cellphone kag indi siya maka-kontak sa iya pamilya kag mga abyan.
english: He almost lost hope because he couldn't reach his cellphone and he couldn't contact his family and friends.

text: Suno sa Indiana State Police, anum ka adlaw ang ginlawig ni Reum nga nakabarikutot lang sa sulod sang salakyan kag nagainom lang sang tubig-ulan.
english: According to the Indiana State Police, Reum spent six days curled up inside the car and drinking only rainwater.

text: Sang Disyembre 26, isa ka adlaw pagkatapos sang Paskuwa, may duha ka lalaki nga nagpaliwa-liwa kag naghagaday nga magpangisda samtang nagahulat sila sa ila nga mga asawa.
english: On December 26, the day after Easter, two men went out for a walk and invited them to go fishing while they waited for their wives.

text: Didto kag ila nanotisyaran nga may maga-idlak sa idalom sang taytay, kag sang ginpalapitan, wasak ini nga pickup nga may sulod pa nga tawo.
english: They noticed that there was a light under the bridge, and when they approached, it was a broken pickup with people still inside.

text: Suno sa nakakita nga si Mario Garcia, 60, ginpinsar niya nga patay na ang lalaki apang sang gintandog niya ang abaga sini, amo na lang ang iya kakibot nga naghulag si Reum kag nakahambal pa.
english: Eyewitness Mario Garcia, 60, said he thought the man was dead but when he touched his shoulder, he was surprised that Reum moved and could speak.

text: Gin-airlift si Reum kag gindala sa ospital bangud sa iya mga samad nga delikado suno sa pulis kag posible gid nga iya ikamatay kun wala ini gilayon nakit-an.
english: Reum was airlifted and taken to the hospital with injuries that police said were serious and could have been fatal if he had not been found immediately.

text: Gindugang man sang pulis nga pananglitan nagtinir pa si Reum sang isa pa gid ka gab-i sa amo nga salakyan sa idalom sang taytay, posible nga indi na masarangan sang lawas sini ang temperatura.
english: The police added that if Reum had stayed another night in the vehicle under the bridge, his body might not have been able to cope with the temperature.

text: Gin-utod ang tiil sini kag nagapabilin subong sa intensive care suno sa Boilermakers Local 374 union.
english: His leg was amputated and he now remains in intensive care, according to the Boilermakers Local 374 union.

text: “Matt Reum wants to thank everyone for the outpouring of support and all the well wishes, including the good Samaritans who found him, the first responders and his caregivers at Memorial Hospital,” kabahin sang statement sang Beacon Health System.
english: “Matt Reum wants to thank everyone for the outpouring of support and all the well wishes, including the good Samaritans who found him, the first responders and his caregivers at Memorial Hospital,” part of the statement by Beacon Health System.

text: Sa subong, nagapabilin nga kritikal ang kondisyon sang pasyente.
english: The patient remains in critical condition.

text: “Matt knows he has a story to tell, and when he is ready, he plans to share details of that experience,” kabahin pa sang statement.# (Photo: WGN)
english: “Matt knows he has a story to tell, and when he is ready, he plans to share details of that experience,” the statement added.# (Photo: WGN)

text:
KON NAGAHATAG sa karon ang gobyerno nasyonal sang
P100,000 bilang cash gift sa aton katigulangan sa ila paglab-ut sa edad nga 100
anyos, ang siyudad sang Iloilo luyag pa maghatag sing dugang nga benepisyo sa
sining mga centenarian naton sa siyudad.
english:
IF the national government currently provides
P100,000 as a cash gift to our ancestors on their 100th birthday
years, the city of Iloilo wants to give more benefits to
of our centenarians in the city.

text:
In fact, aprubado na ang Ilonggo Centenarian
Ordinance, as amended, nga ginduso sang sini lang ni Liga President kag
ex-officio Councilor Irene Ong, nga ginpapasar naman sang tanan nga mga myembro
sang Konseho sa ila sesyon sadtong Disyembre 5, 2019.
english:
In fact, the Ilonggo Centenarian has been approved
Ordinance, as amended, proposed recently by Liga President and
ex-officio Councilor Irene Ong, which was passed by all members
of the Council at its session on December 5, 2019.

text:
Ang orihinal nga ordinansa nga ginduso sadtong 2016
sang nagtaliwan nga Councilor Armand Parcon nagapain sang dugang nga P50,000
para sa ila agud mangin P150,000 ini sa paglab-ut nila sing 100 anyos.
english:
The original ordinance proposed in 2016
of the late Councilor Armand Parcon allocates an additional P50,000
for them to be P150,000 when they reach 100 years.

text:
Sa amended nga version ni Councilor Ong, indi lang
gindugangan ining P50,000 nga cash gift sa idalom sang Parcon Ordinance.
english:
In Councilor Ong’s amended version, not only
increased this P50,000 cash gift under the Parcon Ordinance.

text:
Nangin
P80,000 na ini sa idalom sang Ong Ordinance nga ihatag na sing amat-amat sa ila
pag-edad sing 80 anyos, dason 90 anyos, kag sa paglab-ut na nila sing 100
anyos.
english:
Become
P80,000 under the Ong Ordinance will be given to them gradually
age 80, then 90, and when they reach 100
years old.

text:
“Pasadyahon ta pa ang ila nabilin nga kabuhi sing
mas temprano pa paagi sa amat-amat nga paghatag sini sa ila sugod sa edad pa
lang nga 80 anyos.
english:
“Let's make the rest of their lives happy
earlier by giving it to them gradually from an early age
only 80 years old.

text:
Sa matuod, laban sa ila indi na maka-enjoy sang ano man nga
cash gift kon pahulaton ta pa sila sa edad nga 100 anyos,” siling gani ni
Councilor Ong.
english:
In fact, most of them can no longer enjoy any
cash gift if we make them wait until they are 100 years old,” he said
Councilor Ong.

text:
Sunu sa sining amended version ni Councilor Ong,
ang maglab-ut sa edad nga 80 anyos may mabaton na nga P10,000, P20,000 sa
paglab-ut 90 anyos, kag P50,000 paglab-ut sa 100 ka tuig.
english:
According to this amended version of Councilor Ong,
those who reach the age of 80 will receive P10,000, P20,000 in
reaching 90 years, and P50,000 reaching 100 years.

text:
Tandaan ugaling nga ining mga benepisyo indi
retroactive ang pagpatuman sini, ukon indi pabalik ang pag-isip sang edad.
english:
Keep in mind however that these benefits are not
its implementation is retroactive, or the age is not counted backwards.

text: Prospective ini, katulad sang kinaandan nga pagpatuman sang aton kasuguan.
english: This is prospective, like the usual implementation of our law.

text:
In other words, mabaton mo ang cash gift nga
P10,000 paglab-ut mo na sing 80 anyos; ang P20,000 paglab-ut mo na 90 anyos;
kag ang P50,000 paglab-ut mo na 100 anyos, kon sa diin mabaton mo ang bug-os
nga P150,000 upod sa P100,000 sa idalom sang Centenarian Act of 2016 sang
gobyerno nasyonal.
english:
In other words, you will receive the cash gift that
P10,000 when you reach 80 years of age; P20,000 when you reach 90 years of age;
and P50,000 when you reach 100 years of age, where you will receive the full
of P150,000 along with P100,000 under the Centenary Act of 2016 of
national government.

text:

Na-shock ang Duterte government sa paghibalo nga
ginasukot ini sang Manila Water kag Maynilad sang ila kapierdihan sa ila
negosyo sa pag-deliver sang tubig sa ila concession areas sa Luzon.
english:
***

The Duterte government was shocked to learn that
Manila Water and Maynilad are paying for their losses to their
water delivery business in their concession areas in Luzon.

text: Sus, kag kadaku gid!
english: Sus, and it's so big!

text:
Ang Manila Water gapanukot sa
gobyerno sing PhP 7.39 ka bilyon (US$144 ka milyon) agud ibayad ini sa ila kuno
kapierdihan nga na-sufrir sa tunga-tunga ang Hunyo 2015 tubtub Nobyembre 2019.
english:
Manila Water charges
government PhP 7.39 billion (US$144 million) to pay it to their alleged
losses suffered between June 2015 and November 2019.

text:
Ining sulukton sa gobyerno gin-award sang Permanent
Court of Arbitration sa Singapore.
english:
This government charge was awarded by the Permanent
Court of Arbitration in Singapore.

text:
Sadtong 2018, ang Duterte government gin-orderan
man sa pagbayad sang P3.4 ka bilyon (US$6.5 ka milyon) sang amo gihapon nga
korte sa Singapore tungod ang Fiipinas wala nagtugot nga pasakaan ang
pagpanukot sa tubig sa mga water consumers halin sadtong 2013 tubtub 2017.
english:
In 2018, the Duterte government was ordered
also to pay P3.4 billion (US$6.5 million) of the same
court in Singapore because the Philippines did not allow the prosecution of
water billing to water consumers from 2013 to 2017.

text:
Ini kuno nga sulukton sa gobyerno ginasaad sa
kontrata sining duha ka water concessionaire nga ginpirmahan nila upod sa
gobyerno sadtong panahon pa ni anay Presidente Fidel Ramos sadtong 1997.
english:
This supposed payment to the government is promised in
contract between these two water concessionaires that they signed with
government during the time of former President Fidel Ramos in 1997.

text:
Ngaa kuno ugaling sukton ang gobyerno sa idalom ni
Duterte kay wala nakigbahin ini sa ining kontrata nga, sa siling niya kag sang
iya mga fiscal advisers, “onerous”, ukon daku nga huol,  kag “disadvantageous”, ukon disbentaha kaayo,
sa gobyerno kag sa mga pumuluyo?
english:
Why should the government under
Duterte because it did not participate in this contract that, according to him and the
his fiscal advisers, “onerous”, or great strain,  and “disadvantageous”, or very disadvantaged,
to the government and to the people?

text:
“Pasugtan na sila sa pagusto nga pagdala sang ila
negosyo, karon pabayaron pa kita sang ila kapierdihan,” paathag gani ni Duterte
sa kaundan sang iya pahayag.
english:
“They will be allowed to carry their
business, now they will make us pay for their losses,” Duterte explained
on the content of his statement.

text:
Daw luyag pa gani ipahangop ni Presidente nga indi
niya pabayaron ang gobyerno sa sining kuno ginpamierde sang duha ka kompaniya.
english:
The President even seems to want to imply that no
he will make the government pay for the alleged losses of the two companies.

text:
Pinahog pa niya ang Manila Water kag Maynilad nga i-akusar sing “economic
sabotage”.
english:
He even threatened to sue Manila Water and Maynilad for “economic
sabotage”.

text:
Luyag man niya nga ipa-revise ining mga kontrata pabor sa gobyerno
kag sa mga pumuluyo.
english:
He also wants to have these contracts revised in favor of the government
and to the citizens.

text:
Samtang, ginpaathag man sang Manila Water kag
Maynilad kon ngaa sila namierde.
english:
Meanwhile, Manila Water and
Maynilad why they lost.

text:
Ina kuno tungod kay wala sila ginpasugtan sang

That's supposedly because they weren't allowed by the
government to raise water consumers' fees so that they do not
ruling.

text: Sa muling pagbubukas ng klase ngayong taon sa Ukraine, hindi silid-aralan kundi mga underground school ang pinasok ng libu-libong bata, kabilang ang mga nasa lungsod ng Kharkiv, upang makapag-aral sa gitna ng patuloy na banta ng digmaan.
english: With the reopening of classes this year in Ukraine, thousands of children, including those in the city of Kharkiv, entered not classrooms but underground schools to study amid the continuing threat of war.

text: Nasa labingpitong libong batang Ukrainian ang nagsimula ng klase sa mga eskwelahang itinayo sa ilalim ng lupa sa Kharkiv, ang pangalawa sa pinakamalaking lungsod ng Ukraine at madalas target ng Russian attacks.
english: About 17,000 Ukrainian children have started classes in underground schools in Kharkiv, Ukraine's second-largest city and a frequent target of Russian attacks.

text: Ayon sa lokal na pamahalaan, pito na ang gumaganang underground school at inaasahang madaragdagan pa ito.
english: According to the local government, there are seven underground schools and more are expected.

text: Ilan sa mga paaralang ito ay matatagpuan sa Northern Saltivka, malapit sa border ng Russia.
english: Some of these schools are located in Northern Saltivka, near the Russian border.

text: Isang magulang, si Anastasia Pochergina, ang nagbahagi na hindi nila inaasahang magiging posible ang physical classes ngayong taon, ngunit labis umano ang kanyang kagustuhan na makaranas ng normal na pag-aaral ang kanyang anak.
english: One parent, Anastasia Pochergina, shared that they did not expect physical classes to be possible this year, but she said she wanted her child to experience a normal education.

text: Tatlong palapag ang lalim ng eskwelahan na kanilang pinasukan, at sinabing ito ang pinakamalalim sa buong Kharkiv.
english: The school they entered was three stories deep, and was said to be the deepest in all of Kharkiv.

text: Dagdag pa ng alkalde ng lungsod na si Ihor Terekhov, anim na istasyon ng metro train ang ginawang mga silid-aralan, upang mabigyan ng kahit kaunting normal na karanasan ang mga bata sa gitna ng digmaan.
english: City Mayor Ihor Terekhov added that six metro train stations have been turned into classrooms, to give children a little normal experience in the middle of the war.

text: Isa sa mga estudyanteng si Maria Yampolska, anim na taong gulang, ay masayang ibinahagi ang kanyang unang karanasan sa pagguhit at paglalaro sa loob ng silid-aralan.
english: One of the students, Maria Yampolska, six years older, happily shared her first experience of drawing and playing in the classroom.

text: Hindi raw siya nakapasok ng kindergarten; dahil sa giyera.
english: He didn't go to kindergarten; because of the war.

text: Naka-alerto sagihapon ang pila ka mga barangay sa siudad sang Iloilo ilabi na ang yara sa mga coastal areas matapos nga nagsulod na Bagyo Basyang sa Philippine Area of Responsibility.
english: Some barangays in Iloilo City are still on alert especially those in the coastal areas after Typhoon Basyang entered the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Punong Barangay Judy ‘Nonoy’ Navales sang Rizal Palapala II nga isa man ka coastal barangay, iya ginpahayag nga nagrekorida na kagab-i ang ila mga opisyales agud nga maghatag sang pahanumdom sa publiko ilabi na ang pag-evacuate kun kinahanglanon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Punong Barangay Judy 'Nonoy' Navales of Rizal Palapala II, another coastal barangay, said their officials went on a tour last night to remind the public especially to evacuate if necessary.

text: Suno kay Navales, mabudlay ang pagpa-evacuate sa mga pumuluyo bangud nga madamo sa mga ini amo ang nahadluk nga bayaan ang ila nga mga puluy-an rason nga nagapangduha-duha pa ang mga residente.
english: According to Navales, it is difficult to evacuate the residents because many of them are afraid to leave their homes, which is why the residents are still hesitant.

text: Pahayag pa niya nga yara sa 20 ka mga panimalay ang ginakabig nga yara sa coastal area sa barangay.
english: He said about 20 households are considered to be in the coastal area of ​​the barangay.

text: Dugang pa ni Navales nga samtang wala pa sang madamol nga ulan, mas maayo nga preparahan gid ang mga kinahanglanun inkaso kinahanglan na nga mag-evacuate.
english: Navales added that while there is no heavy rain, it is better to prepare the necessities in case of need to evacuate.

text: Ginapaaligmat sang awtoridad ang publiko bangud sa ginaantisipar nga mangin epekto ni Bagyo Basyang sa probinsya sang Iloilo umpisa alas singko karon sa hapon.
english: Authorities are warning the public about the anticipated impact of Typhoon Basyang in Iloilo province starting at 5 pm today.

text: Apang suno kay Dr. Alfonso Baldonado III, manager sang Emergency Operations Center sang Iloilo Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office, ang maayo nga balita subong nga adlaw amo nga nagluya ang bagyo kag ginpanubo sang state weather bureau sa kategorya nga tropical depression halin sa tropical storm.
english: But according to Dr. Alfonso Baldonado III, manager of the Emergency Operations Center of the Iloilo Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office, the good news today is that the typhoon has weakened and the state weather bureau has downgraded it to the category of tropical depression from tropical storm.

text: Sa 11:00 sa aga nga bulletin, nakasaad nga dala sang bagyo ang kabaskugon sang hangin nga 55 kph kag pagmadlos nga tubtub sa 70 kph.
english: The 11:00 am bulletin predicted that the typhoon would bring winds of 55 kph and gusts of up to 70 kph.

text: Ulihi nakit-an ang sentro sang bagyo sa kadagatan sang Anda, Bohol kag nagahulag sa direksyon nga pa-nakatundan naaminhan-nakatundan sa kadasigon nga 10 kph.
english: The center of the typhoon was later located in the waters of Anda, Bohol and is moving in a west northwest direction at 10 kph.

text:
Kun lantawon ang forecast track, magalabay ang sentro sang bagyo (ukon mag-landfall mismo) sa Bohol, southern Cebu, kag Negros Oriental halin karon sa hapon kag sa gab-i.

Buwas sa hapon naman ukon sa gab-i, magalabay ini malapit sa southern Panay Island.
english:
According to the forecast track, the center of the typhoon will pass (or landfall itself) in Bohol, southern Cebu, and Negros Oriental from this afternoon and evening.

Tomorrow afternoon or evening, it will pass near southern Panay Island.

text: Suno kay Baldonado, sa latest record sang talatapan, may masobra sa 600 ka mga pasahero nga na-stranded sa probinsya bangud sa malain nga tyempo partikular sa pantalan sa Dumangas kag sa Ajuy.
english: According to Baldonado, according to the latest record of the office, there are more than 600 passengers stranded in the province due to bad weather particularly at the ports of Dumangas and Ajuy.

text: Magluwas diri, wala pa sang nakasulod nga report nga may apektado ukon nahalitan nga populasyon, mga dam, ukon sa sector sang agrikultura nga mahimo maangot sa bagyo.
english: In addition, there have been no reports of affected or damaged populations, dams, or the agricultural sector that could be linked to the typhoon.

text: Epektibo alas otso kaina sang aga, ginpasaka ang status sang bug-os nga probinsya sang Iloilo sa Red Alert.
english: Effective at 8 am yesterday, the status of the entire province of Iloilo was raised to Red Alert.

text: Ini nagakahulugan nga ang tanan nga concerned agencies kag local government units (LGUs) ang dapat nga maghulag gilayon kag mag-implementar sang nagakaigo nga safety measures.
english: This means that all concerned agencies and local government units (LGUs) must act immediately and implement appropriate safety measures.

text: Kadam-an man sa LGUs sa probinsya ang nagdeklarar sang suspension sang klase subong nga adlaw agud maproteksyunan ang mga estudyante sa malain nga panahon.#
english: Most LGUs in the province have also declared the suspension of classes today to protect students from bad weather.

english: The other companions of businessman Atong Ang pleaded NOT GUILTY in the Lipa City Regional Trial Court in the case they are facing in connection with the missing sabungeros.

text: Gin-akusahan ang mga ini sang kidnapping kag homicide bangud sang ginaalegar malain nga mga buluhaton kaangay sang indi patas nga paghampang sa AA Cobra Game Farm.
english: They were charged with kidnapping and homicide for alleged wrongdoing such as unfair play at the AA Cobra Game Farm.

text: Nakaskedyul ang pre-marking of evidence sa Pebrero 20, samtang ang hearing sa kaso pagahiwaton sa Pebrero 27.
english: The pre-marking of evidence is scheduled for February 20, while the hearing in the case will be held on February 27.

text: Samtang, nagapabilin naman nga nagapanago si Atong Ang suno sa awtoridad.
english: Meanwhile, Atong Ang remains in hiding, according to authorities.

text: Suno naman sa Department of Interior and Local Government, nakapadala na sila sang personnel agud kumpirmahon ang report nga ara si Ang sa Cambodia.
english: According to the Department of Interior and Local Government, they have already sent personnel to confirm the report that Ang is in Cambodia.

text: Nalakip sa pito ka persons of interest ang isa ka menor de edad sa kamatayon sang pito ka tuig nga bata nga babayi nga nasulod sa sako, may higot ang liog, kag wala na sang pang-idalom nga panapton sa Brgy.
english: Among the seven persons of interest is a minor in the death of a seven-year-old girl who was in a sack, with a rope around her neck, and no underwear in Brgy.

text: Tampucao, Lambunao, Iloilo.
english: Tampucao, Lambunao, Iloilo.

english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Jose Winston Biadog, chief of Lambunao Municipal Police Station, said the seven persons of interest were neighbors of the victim and also looked at the time of the crime.

text: Dugang pa ni Biadog, nadala na ini sa crime lab agud nga ipaidalom sa swabbing kag nagkooperar man ang mga ini.
english: Biadog said he was taken to the crime lab for swabbing and they cooperated.

text: Isa ka sahi sang skin inflammation ang psoriasis sa diin ang lawas sang tawo ang makaangkon sang abnormalidad sa paghimo sang skin cells.
english: Psoriasis is a type of skin inflammation in which the human body develops abnormalities in the production of skin cells.

text: Sa programa Dr. Bombo, ginpahayag ni Dr. Elvin Tiangha nga ang proseso sang pagbaylo sang panit sang isa ka tawo ang nagalab-ot sa 28 tubtob 30 ka adlaw apang sa kondisyon sang Psoriasis, nagalab-ot lamang sang tatlo tubtob apat ka adlaw ang bilog nga proseso sa pagbaylo sang panit sang tawo.
english: In the program Dr. Bombo, said Dr. Elvin Tiangha said the process of transforming a person's skin takes 28 to 30 days but in the case of psoriasis, the entire process of transforming a person's skin takes only three to four days.

text: Ini ang rason sa pag-angkon sang pagpalangdamol kag paghimbis sang panit.
english: This is the reason for the thickening and scaling of the skin.

text: Suno kay Dr. Tiangha indi pa gid mapat-od ang gintunaan sang psoriasis apang base sa mga mangin-alamon sa medisina, mahimo makuha ang psoriasis sa pamilya, mahina nga immune system kag sa palibot.
english: According to Dr. The cause of psoriasis is still unknown but according to medical experts, psoriasis can be caused by family, weak immune system and environmental factors.

text: Kun eczema naman ang pagahambalan, ini ang ginakabig long-term condition nga nagaapekto sa panit.
english: When it comes to eczema, it is considered a long-term condition that affects the skin.

text: Ini ang mapula kag sa palibot sini ang maitom.
english: It is red and around it is black.

text: Nagatuhaw ang eczema sa sulod sang siko, likod sang kamot kag likod man sang tuhod kag kadam-an nga nagakaangkon sini amo ang mga bata.
english: Eczema occurs on the inside of the elbow, back of the hand and also behind the knee and is mostly affected by children.

text: Samtang ang psoriasis naman ang makit-an sa guwa sang siko ukon kabaliskaran sang eczema kag ang masami ginatubo-an amo ang mga teenagers ukon adults.
english: Psoriasis, on the other hand, is found outside the elbow or the opposite of eczema and is most common in teenagers or adults.

text: Agud nga malikawan ang pag-angkon sang psoriasis pahayag sang eksperto, likawan ang pagbulad sa initan, pag-inom sang makahulubog nga ilimnon, pagpanigarilyo, likawan man ang stress kag ipabilin ang healthy lifestyle.
english: To prevent the development of psoriasis, the expert said, avoid exposure to heat, drinking alcohol, smoking, avoid stress and maintain a healthy lifestyle.

english: The study was published Wednesday, August 27, in PLOS One.

text: Pinangalanang Kostensuchus atrox, kabilang ito sa naglahong pamilya ng Peirosauridae.
english: Named Kostensuchus atrox, it belongs to the extinct family Peirosauridae.

text: Natagpuan ito malapit sa El Calafate, Santa Cruz Province, ng pangkat na pinamunuan ng paleontologist na sina Fernando Novas at Diego Pol, katuwang ang mga mananaliksik mula Japan.
english: It was found near El Calafate, Santa Cruz Province, by a team led by paleontologists Fernando Novas and Diego Pol, along with researchers from Japan.

text: Kabilang sa natagpuang labi ang halos kumpletong bungo na halos 50 sentimetro ang haba, pati na rin ang malaking bahagi ng kalansay.
english: Among the remains found was an almost complete skull about 50 centimeters long, as well as a large part of the skeleton.

text: Batay sa pagsusuri, higit na panlupa ang pamumuhay ng buwayang ito kumpara sa mga modernong uri na karaniwang naninirahan sa tubig.
english: Based on the analysis, this crocodile lives more terrestrially than modern species that usually live in water.

text: Tinatayang higit sa 3 metro (10 talampakan) ang haba ng buong katawan, kaya’t maituturing itong pangunahing maninila sa panahon nito.
english: It is estimated to be more than 3 meters (10 feet) long, making it the main predator of its time.

text: May kakaibang hugis ang bungo—mas maikli, malapad at matibay kumpara sa mga kaanak nito.
english: The skull has a unique shape—shorter, wider and stronger than its relatives.

text: Mayroon itong mahigit 50 matutulis na ngipin, ang ilan ay umaabot ng higit 5 sentimetro ang haba, na may talim na angkop sa paghiwa ng laman.
english: It has more than 50 sharp teeth, some reaching more than 5 centimeters long, with a sharp edge suitable for cutting flesh.

text:
Ang malalim na ibabang panga ay nagpapahiwatig ng napakalakas na kagat, patunay ng pagiging dominanteng mandaragit nito

Ayon sa mga mananaliksik, naiiba ito sa mga modernong buwaya na kadalasang nakalubog sa tubig.
english:
The deep lower jaw indicates a very strong bite, evidence of its dominant predator

According to the researchers, it differs from modern crocodiles that are often submerged in water.

text: Ang mataas na bungo, gilid na posisyon ng mga mata, at pasulong na butas ng ilong ay palatandaan ng pagiging mas panlupa.
english: The high skull, sideways position of the eyes, and forward nostrils are signs of being more foreign.

text: Itinuturing ng mga eksperto na mahalaga ang tuklas na ito dahil nagpapakita ito ng lawak ng ekolohikal na papel ng mga buwaya sa Timog Amerika bago ang malawakang pagkalipol 66 milyong taon na ang nakararaan.
english: Experts say the discovery is important because it shows the extensive ecological role of crocodiles in South America before the mass extinction 66 million years ago.

text: Nagpagwa sang bag-o nga mando ang Department of Trade and Industry nga nagarequire sa online sellers sang mga household appliances, electronics kag iban pa nga mga consumer goods nga magparehistro sa ahensya.
english: The Department of Trade and Industry has issued a new order requiring online sellers of household appliances, electronics and other consumer goods to register with the agency.

text: Sa idalom sang Department Administrative Order (DAO) 25-02 nga gin-aprubahan sang Pebrero 21, ang DTI nagsiling nga ang mga online merchants kag e-retailers nga nagabaligya sang mga produkto sang mga konsumidor nga napaidalom sa mandatory certification gikan sa Bureau of Philippine Standards (BPS), dapat magkumpleto sang isa ka beses nga pagparehistro paagi sa online portal sang bureau.
english: Under Department Administrative Order (DAO) 25-02 approved on February 21, the DTI said online merchants and e-retailers selling consumer products that are subject to mandatory certification from the Bureau of Philippine Standards (BPS), must complete a registration portal through the bureau’s online registration portal.

text: Ang mga produkto nga subject sa mandatory certification amo ang mga kinahanglan nga may marka sang Philippine Standard (PS) ukon Import Commodity Clearance (ICC) antes ibaligya sa merkado agud masiguro nga ini nagasanto sa nagakaigo nga mga pagsulundan sang kalidad kag safety standards.
english: Products subject to mandatory certification are those that are required to be marked with the Philippine Standard (PS) or Import Commodity Clearance (ICC) before being sold in the market to ensure that they meet relevant quality guidelines and safety standards.

text: Suspendido ang klase sa tanan nga lebel sa pampubliko kag pribado nga mga eskwelahan sa syudad sang Iloilo buwas, Pebrero 6.
english: Classes at all levels in public and private schools in Iloilo City will be suspended tomorrow, February 6.

text: Sandig ini sa gin-anunsyo ni Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas subong nga gab-i agud maproteksyunan ang mga kabataan sa mangin epekto ni Bagyo Basyang.
english: This is based on the announcement of Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas tonight to protect children from the effects of Typhoon Basyang.

text: “To ensure the safety sang pinalangga naton nga mga estudyante, face to face classes are suspended tomorrow, February 6, 2026 and shift to Alternative Delivery Mode, on All Levels in Public and Private schools in Iloilo City,” kabahin sang anunsyo sang alcalde.
english: “To ensure the safety of our beloved students, face to face classes are suspended tomorrow, February 6, 2026 and shift to Alternative Delivery Mode, on All Levels in Public and Private schools in Iloilo City,” the mayor announced.

text: Sa 8:00 weather bulletin sang PAGASA, nakasaad nga napasaka sa Tropical Cyclone Wind Signal No.
english: In the 8:00 weather bulletin of PAGASA, it is stated that Tropical Cyclone Wind Signal No.

text: 1 ang bilog nga Western Visayas ukon ang Guimaras, Iloilo, Capiz, Aklan, kag Antique.
english: 1 the entire Western Visayas or Guimaras, Iloilo, Capiz, Aklan, and Antique.

text: Ulihi nakit-an ang sentro sang bagyo sa kalayuon nga 115 km nasidlangan sang Hinatuan, Surigao del Sur.
english: Ulihi nakit-an ang sentro sang bagyo sa kalayuon nga 115 km nasidlangan sang Hinatuan, Surigao del Sur.

text:
Dala sini ang kabaskugon sang hangin nga 75 km/h malapit sa sentro kag pagmadlos nga tubtub sa 90 km/h.

Nagahulag ang bagyo sa direksyon nga pa-nakatundan naaminhan-nakatundan sa kadasigon nga 20 km/h.

Sa forecast track, maga-landfall ang sentro sang bagyo sa Surigao del Sur subong nga kagab-ihon ukon buwas sa kaagahon.
english:
It brought winds of 75 km/h near the center and gusts of up to 90 km/h.

The storm is moving in a west northwest direction at 20 km/h.

According to the forecast track, the center of the typhoon will landfall in Surigao del Sur tonight or tomorrow morning.

text:
Matapos makatabok sa Mindanao, magatuhaw ini sa Bohol Sea buwas sa aga kag maglabay malapit (ukon mag-landfall) sa Siquijor kag sa southern portion sang Negros Oriental sa buwas sang hapon ukon sa gab-i.

Sa buwas sang gab-i ukon sa Sabado sang kaagahon, magatuhaw ini sa Sulu Sea, kag magalaslas sa northern portion sang Palawan sa Sabado sang hapon tubtub sa gab-i.

Ginalantaw nga magahina ini kag mahimo nga low pressure area sa Sabado sang hapon ukon sa gab-i.
english:
After crossing Mindanao, it will emerge in the Bohol Sea tomorrow morning and pass near (or landfall) Siquijor and the southern portion of Negros Oriental tomorrow afternoon or evening.

Tomorrow night or Saturday morning, it will emerge in the Sulu Sea, and will hit the northern portion of Palawan on Saturday afternoon until evening.

It is expected to weaken and could become a low pressure area by Saturday afternoon or evening.

text: Lapaw na sa numero sang missing nga gindeklarar sang Philippine Coast Guard ang numero sang mga nakit-an nga bangkay kasunod sang paglugdang sang M/V Trisha Kerstin 3 sa Basilan.
english: The number of bodies found following the sinking of the M/V Trisha Kerstin 3 in Basilan has exceeded the number of missing persons declared by the Philippine Coast Guard.

text: Buot silingon, may mga pasahero nga wala nakalista sa manifesto sang barko antes natabo ang trahedya sang Enero 26.
english: In other words, there were passengers who were not listed on the ship’s manifest before the January 26 tragedy occurred.

text: Suno kay Celso Lobregat, Executive Secretary sang City Mayor’s office sang Zambonga City, gin-ako sang iban nga mga survivors nga nagbakal sila sang ticket sa sulod na mismo sang barko ukon sa scalpers, gani wala sila nadala sa opisyal nga listahan sang mga sakay.
english: According to Celso Lobregat, Executive Secretary of the City Mayor's office of Zambonga City, some survivors admitted that they bought tickets inside the ship or from scalpers, so they were not included in the official list of passengers.

text: Matandaan nga sa una nga pahayag sang Philippine Coast Guard, 18 ka bangkay ang na-recover kag 10 pa ang missing nga padayon nga ginapangita.
english: According to the Philippine Coast Guard, 18 bodies have been recovered and 10 are still missing.

text: Apang sa subong, naglab-ot na sa 33 ang kabug-usan nga numero sang mga napatay nga narekober.
english: However, the total number of recoveries has now reached

text: Gin-ako sang Philippine Coast Guard nga ang una nga datos ang nabase lamang sa manifesto, gani padayon pa ang imbestigasyon nahanungod sa matuod nga kadamuon sang sakay kag sa ginhalinan sang paglugdang sang amo nga Roll On-Roll Off vessel.
english: The Philippine Coast Guard acknowledged that the initial data is based only on the manifest, so the investigation is still ongoing regarding the true number of passengers and the cause of the sinking of the Roll On-Roll Off vessel.

text: Ginsaysay man sang mga nakaluwas nga tuman nga kabudlayan nga ila gin-agyan sa dagat samtang nagahulat sang bulig sa tunga sang madulom kag matugnaw nga sitwasyon.
english: The survivors also recounted the extreme hardships they went through at sea while waiting for help amid the dark and cold situation.

text: Sa karon padayon naman nga ginapangita pa ang iban nga nadula.
english: The search for the other missing persons is ongoing.

text: Nalutos ang Miami Heat sa kamot sang Denver Nuggets, 133-113, kadungan sang pagbalik ni Jimmy Butler gikan sa suspension sa pito ka mga hampang.
english: The Miami Heat lost at the hands of the Denver Nuggets, 133-113, coinciding with Jimmy Butler’s return from a seven-game suspension.

text: Naka-skor ang 35-anyos nga forward sang 18 points sa 33 minutos sini nga paghampang para sa Heat sa Florida.
english: The 35-year-old forward scored 18 points in 33 minutes playing for the Heat in Florida.

text:
Antes ang aktwal nga hampang batok kay Nikola Jokic, ginsapubliko ni Butler ang iya pagbalik paagi lamang sa duha ka tinaga nga “I’m back.”

Nauna na nga ginhambal ni Butler nga indi siya malipayon subong nga regular season, pila ka beses na nga naghaboy sang kritisismo, kag nag-request sang trade.
english:
Before the actual game against Nikola Jokic, Butler made his return public with just the two words “I’m back.”

Butler has previously said he wasn’t happy this regular season, threw criticism several times, and requested a trade.

text:
Enero 13 sang ginsuspend siya sang Heat bangud sa rason nga “conduct detrimental to the team.”

Bisan pa na-suspend, ginsulit sini nga luyag sini nga ma-trade sa iban nga team, apang sa iya pagbalik sa hampang, wala man sang tinimok-timok kag wala gid namensyonar ni Miami coach Erik Spoelstra ang pangalan sang Miami superstar.
english:
He was suspended by the Heat on January 13 for “conduct detrimental to the team.”

Despite being suspended, he reiterated that he wanted to be traded to another team, but when he returned to the game, there were no signs and Miami coach Erik Spoelstra never mentioned the name of the Miami superstar.

text: Kun balikan ang isyu, nasapubliko ang tension sa tunga ni Butler kag Miami sang nakakas sa NBA playoffs ang Miami bangud sa Boston Celtics.
english: Looking back on the issue, the tension between Butler and Miami became public when Miami was eliminated from the NBA playoffs by the Boston Celtics.

text: Wala nakahampang si Butler sa five-game series bangud sa knee injury, kag gin-alegar nga nagpanginit ang team president nga si Pat Riley sang nagsiling si Butler nga nalutos kuntani nila ang Celtics kun nakahampang siya para sa team.
english: Butler missed the five-game series with a knee injury, and team president Pat Riley allegedly got heated when Butler said they would have beaten the Celtics if he had played for the team.

text: May nagaalegar man nga gusto ni Butler sang contract extension nga duha ka tuig nga $113 million max extension, apang wala sang plano ang Heat, rason nga diskuntento man ang six-time All-Star kag nagahingyo na sang trade.
english: There are also allegations that Butler wants a two-year contract extension of $113 million max extension, but the Heat have no plans, which is why the six-time All-Star is also dissatisfied and is asking for a trade.

text: May average si Butler nga 17.6 points, 5.4 rebounds kag 4.6 assists sa 23 games kag ini na ang pang-anum niya nga season sa Miami.
english: Butler is averaging 17.6 points, 5.4 rebounds and 4.6 assists in 23 games and is in his sixth season with Miami.

text: Sunod nga atubangon sang Miami ang San Antonio Spurs 4:00 buwas sa aga, oras sa Pilipinas.
english: Miami will next face the San Antonio Spurs at 4:00 am tomorrow morning, Philippine time.

text: Indi matapos-tapos ang pasalamat sang isa ka 22-anyos nga iloy sang nakit-an nga buhi pa ang iya apat ka bulan nga lapsag apisar nga ginlupad na ini sang buhawi kag narumpag na ang ila nga balay.
english: A 22-year-old mother is grateful to find her four-month-old baby alive despite being blown away by the typhoon and their house collapsing.

text: Natabo ini sa Tennessee sa USA kun sa diin anum ka mga tawo ang napatay kag linibo ang nawad-an sang suplay sang kuryente sang naglaslas ang buhawi sang nagligad lamang nga semana.
english: This happened in Tennessee in the USA where six people were killed and thousands lost power supply when a tornado struck last week.

text: Suno kay Sydney Moore, yara siya sa sulod sang balay kaupod sa iya nga boyfriend nga si  Aramis Youngblood kag kabataan sang nabatyagan nga nag-agi ang buhawi.
english: According to Sydney Moore, she was inside the house with her boyfriend Aramis Youngblood and children when she felt the tornado pass.

text: Dali-dali nga ginluksuhan ni Sydney ang iya isa ka tuig nga subang nga bata kag sang hinali lang, nag-collapse ang dingding sang ila balay.
english: Sydney quickly jumped on her one-year-old son and suddenly, the wall of their house collapsed.

text: “As soon as I jumped on top of Princeton, the back bedroom, the walls collapsed,” suno kay Moore.
english: “As soon as I jumped on top of Princeton, the back bedroom, the walls collapsed,” according to Moore.

text: “I remember me and Princeton got thrown onto the ground and then we got picked up and thrown down again, but he never left my arms.
english: “I remember me and Princeton got thrown onto the ground and then we got picked up and thrown down again, but he never left my arms.

text:
And somehow, someway, I still had his pacifier clenched in my hands.”

Nakit-an man mismo sang iya boyfriend kun paano ginhakop sang buhawi ang balay kag ginhakwat sang hangin ang ginatulugan sang bata.
english:
And somehow, someway, I still had his pacifier clenched in my hands.”

Her boyfriend also saw how the tornado engulfed the house and the wind carried the child's bedroom.

text: Ginhingagaw pa sang lalaki nga malagas ang suludldan, apang mangin siya ang wala nakasarang sa hangin kag nalupad paguwa sa balay.
english: The man tried to throw the container away, but he was the one who couldn't stand the wind and flew out of the house.

text: “I remember the first question I asked [Youngblood] was, ‘Where’s my baby?'” pahayag ni Moore.
english: “I remember the first question I asked [Youngblood] was, ‘Where’s my baby?'” Moore said.

text:
“And he said he didn’t know.”

Sang nagtawhay na ang sitwasyon, ginpangita ni Sydney kag sang iya boyfriend ang bata kag wala sang sudlan ang kakulba kun ano na ang itsura sini.
english:
“And he said he didn’t know.”

When the situation calmed down, Sydney and her boyfriend looked for the child and were worried about what he would look like.

text: Halos 10 minutos ang ginlawig sang ila pagpangita kag indi makapati ang iloy sang nakit-an sini nga nagabugtaw na ang iya baby samtang yara ini malapit sa natumba nga kahoy.
english: The search took almost 10 minutes and the mother could not believe her eyes when she found her baby awake while she was near the fallen tree.

text:
Suno sa iya, wala lang niya ginahambal apang naghuna-huna na siya nga patay na ang bata, gani naghilibion ini sang ginhakos ang lapsag nga iya gintawag nga “grace of God.”

“It was just like he was placed in a tree, like a little tree cradle for a baby.
english:
She said she didn't just say it but she thought the child was dead, so she cried when she hugged the baby whom she called the “grace of God.”

“It was just like he was placed in a tree, like a little tree cradle for a baby.

text:
It was like a cubby hole in a tree, at the bottom.”

Wala man sang naluwas sa ila nga propiedad bangud sa buhawi apang tuman man ang pasalamat ni Sydney sa iya mga kasilingan bangud sang paghatag sang mga gatas, diapers, kag mga bayo para sa iya mga anak.
english:
It was like a cubby hole in a tree, at the bottom.”

No one was saved from their property due to the tornado but Sydney is also very grateful to her neighbors for donating milk, diapers, and clothes for her children.

text: Temporaryo nga nagatinir si Moore kag ang iya boyfriend sa hotel room, samtang gintugyan naman ang duha ka mga bata sa pakaisa ni Moore nga amo ang mas may kaayo nga kahimtangan pagkatapos sang natabo nga buhawi.
english: Moore and her boyfriend were temporarily staying in a hotel room, while the two children were left with Moore's cousin, who was in better shape after the tornado.

text: # (Photo: Sydney Moore via ABC News)
english: # (Photo: Sydney Moore via ABC News)

text: Gintudlo sang Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines nga ang malaba nga pila sang mga pasahero ang rason kun ngaa ginkakas ang initial screening sa Iloilo International Airport.
english: The Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines pointed out that the long queue of passengers was the reason why the initial screening at Iloilo International Airport was removed.

text: Sa ginpatigayon nga committee hearing, nagpahayag si Mr. Arthur Parreño, Terminal Supervisor sang Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (CAAP) nga nakalab-ot na sa talatapan sang Department of Transportation (DOTr) nga madamo ang nagareklamo sa tuman ka laba nga pila rason nga ginpauntat ini sang nagligad nga Oktubre 10, 2025.
english: In the committee hearing, Mr. Arthur Parreño, Terminal Supervisor of the Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (CAAP) said it has reached the office of the Department of Transportation (DOTr) that many people are complaining about the long queue which is why it was stopped last October 10, 2025.

text: Gin-athag man niya nga bisan wala ang initial screening, gindugangan man ang security sa paluparan.
english: He also explained that although there was no initial screening, security at the airport was increased.

text: Ang ginpatigayon nga joint committee hearing sang 15th Sangguniang Panlalawigan ang kasunod sang nagluntad nga shooting incident sa sulod sang Iloilo International Airport sang Enero 28,2026 bangud sa pasahero nga may dala nga kutsilyo kag nagbato sa otoridad sang kumpiskahon kuntani ini.
english: The joint committee hearing of the 15th Sangguniang Panlalawigan follows the shooting incident inside the Iloilo International Airport on January 28, 2026 due to a passenger carrying a knife and throwing stones at the authorities when they tried to confiscate it.

text: ILOILO CITY-Nagaayo si Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.
english: ILOILO CITY-Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr. is recovering.

text: sa mga shipping lines nga indi pagpasobrahan sa 150 nga quota ang numero sang mga Locally Stranded Individuals nga ginapapauli sa Iloilo kada semana.
english: to shipping lines not to exceed the 150 quota for the number of Locally Stranded Individuals sent back to Iloilo each week.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Governor Defensor, iya ginpahayag nga kuntani indi magpinagusto ang mga shipping lines sa pagbaligya sang tickets sang mga pasahero agud masunod ang quota.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Governor Defensor said that shipping lines should not be complacent in selling passenger tickets in order to comply with the quota.

text: Suno kay Defensor, katuyuan sini nga indi magginutok ang mga LSIs sa mga quarantine facilities sa kabanwahanan sa Iloilo kg indi man matam-an ang mga frontliners.
english: According to Defensor, the purpose of this is to prevent the overcrowding of LSIs in the quarantine facilities in the towns of Iloilo and not to overcrowd the frontliners.

text: Gin-athag naman sang gobernador nga wala sang moratorium ang Iloilo angot sa pagpapauli sa mga LSIS.
english: The governor clarified that Iloilo does not have a moratorium on the repatriation of LSIS.

text: Gin-ako sang gobernador nga mangin siya ang natingala man bangud may mga pasahero nga nagareklamo nga indi sila pagpasakyon sa mga barko bangud may moratorium nga ginapatuman ang probinsya.
english: The governor admitted that he was also surprised because there are passengers who complain that they are not allowed to board the ships because there is a moratorium implemented in the province.

text: May kaangtanan naman sa stranded nga mga taga-Iloilo sa pier sa Manila, ginpahayag sang natungdan nga makapakig-angot ini sa shipping line agud mapapauli na ang mga ini.
english: Regarding the stranded Iloilo residents at the pier in Manila, he said he can contact the shipping line to send them home.

text: Sa katuyuan nga papag-unon ang salabton sang mga opisyal sang gobyerno, nag-file si Zamboanga City 1st District.
english: In order to strengthen the accountability of government officials, Zamboanga City 1st District filed.

text: Representative Khymer Adan T. Olaso sang House Bill 1121.
english: Representative Khymer Adam T. Olaso of House Bill 1121.

text: Nasaad sa hagna nga luyag sini nga ibalik ang death penalty pinaagi sa firing squad para sa mga opisyal sang gobyerno nga mapamatud-an nga nakasala sang graft, sala nga paggamit sang pondo sang gobyerno kag plunder sa Sandiganbayan.
english: The bill states that it wants to restore the death penalty through firing squad for government officials found guilty of graft, misuse of government funds and plunder in the Sandiganbayan.

text: Sakop sang hagna ang tanan nga mga opisyal sang gobyerno, anuman ang rangko ukon posisyon, lakip na ang mga ginboto kag gin-appoint nga opisyal halin sa ehekutibo, lehislatibo, kag hudikatura.
english: The bill covers all government officials, regardless of rank or position, including elected and appointed officials from the executive, legislative, and judiciary.

text:
Lakip man diri ang mga opisyal sang constitutional commissions, government-owned and controlled corporations, kag iban pa nga ahensya sang gobyerno

Mangin ang mga miyembro sang Armed Forces of the Philippines kag Philippine National Police ang sakop man sang hagna.
english:
It also includes officials of constitutional commissions, government-owned and controlled corporations, and other government agencies

Even members of the Armed Forces of the Philippines and the Philippine National Police are also covered by the bill.

text: “Binibigyang-diin ng panukala ang pananagutan at paghadlang sa katiwalian, na nagpapakita na ang posisyon sa gobyerno ay isang tiwala ng publiko, at anumang paglabag dito ay nararapat na patawan ng pinakamabigat na parusa,” santo sa paathag sa nakasulat sa hagna.
english: “The bill emphasizes accountability and prevention of corruption, which shows that the position of government is a public trust, and any violation of it deserves the most severe punishment,” according to the explanation written in the bill.

text: Suno kay Rep.
english: According to Rep.

text: Olaso, katuyuan sang hagna nga maghatag sang mensahe nga ang graft kag sala nga paggamit sang pondo sang banwa ang indi pagpasugtan.
english: Olaso said the bill aims to send a message that graft and misuse of city funds will not be tolerated.

text: Pinaagi sa pagbalik sang silot nga kamatayon, luyag sang mamalidha nga mangibabaw ang integridad kag pagsalig sang publiko sa mga institusyon sang gobyerno.
english: By bringing back the death penalty, the lawmaker wants integrity and public trust in government institutions to prevail.

text: Patas na ang record sang Oklahoma City Thunder kag Cleveland Cavaliers nga may tag-34 ka daog kag anum ka kalutusan subong nga regular season sa National Basketball Association (NBA).
english: The Oklahoma City Thunder and Cleveland Cavaliers are tied with 34 wins and six losses this regular season in the National Basketball Association (NBA).

text: Ini matapos nakabalos ang Thunder sa pagpanguna ni Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, 134-114, sa latest game sa Paycom Center sa Oklahoma City.
english: This was after the Thunder avenged a Shai Gilgeous-Alexander lead, 134-114, in the latest game at the Paycom Center in Oklahoma City.

text: 40 points ang napaulan ni Gilgeous-Alexander nga amo ang pang-18 nga 40-point game sa iya karera.
english: Gilgeous-Alexander scored 40 points, the 18th 40-point game of his career.

text: Magluwas diri, nakahimo man ang 26-anyos nga point guard sang eight assists kag three rebounds.
english: In addition, the 26-year-old point guard also managed eight assists and three rebounds.

text: Nangin daku man nga bulig sa opensa si Luguentz Dort nga may yara man sang 22 points, kag si Jalen Williams nga nagdugang sang 19 points.
english: Luguentz Dort, who also had 22 points, and Jalen Williams, who added 19 points, were also a big help on offense.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, nagpanguna sa Cavs si Darius Garland nga may 20 points, samtang otso puntos lamang ang na-produce ni Donovan Mitchell.
english: On the other hand, Darius Garland led the Cavs with 20 points, while Donovan Mitchell produced only eight points.

text: Ang Oklahoma City ang nagapangibabaw subong sa Western Conference, samtang nagapanguna naman sa Eastern Conference ang Cleveland apang may yara sang identical records.
english: Oklahoma City currently dominates the Western Conference, while Cleveland leads the Eastern Conference but has identical records.

text: Antes sini nga hampang, ginlutos sang Cavs ang Thunder, 129-122, sang nagligad nga Huwebes sa Ohio.
english: Prior to this game, the Cavs defeated the Thunder, 129-122, last Thursday in Ohio.

text: Ginalantaw sang kadam-an nga basketball analysts nga ang duha ka nasambit nga teams ang maga-atubangay sa masandukot nga finals sa Hunyo.
english: Most basketball analysts expect the two teams to face each other in the finals in June.

text: Ginsapubliko sang actor-politician nga si Senator Bong Revilla nga may yara siya sang iban pa gid nga kabataan magluwas sa ila mga anak ni Lani Mercado.
english: Actor-politician Senator Bong Revilla has revealed that he has other children besides their children with Lani Mercado.

text: Gin-ako ini ni Revilla kadungan sang media conference sang iya pelikula nga “Walang Matigas na Pulis sa Matigas na Misis” Season 3.

text: May mga warts ka man bala sa nagkalain-lain nga bahin sang imo lawas?

english: According to Dr. Suzanne Olbricht, a dermatologist, warts are often on broken skin or wounds where the virus can quickly enter.

text: Nakahibalo ka bala nga mahimo maglapta ang warts sa imo nga lawas?

text: Gani importante gid ang paghugas sang kamot kag indi pagsagi hikap ang imo nga warts.

english: Warts are inevitable but there are ways to minimize the risk of developing them.

text: Isa sa pinaka importante nag himuon amo nga masami maghugas sang kamot, likawi nga mapilas kag kun gina ingkit mo ang imo kuko, untati na ina bangud ang pag-ingkit sang kuko ang nagahatag sang pamaagi agud nga makasulod ang virus sa imo lawas.
english: One of the most important things to do is to wash your hands often, avoid injuries and if you are biting your nails, stop because biting your nails provides a way for the virus to enter your body.

text: Kun luyag mo nga ipakakas ang warts, mas maayo nga magdangop sa dermatologist bangud may yara sila sang nagkalain lain nga pagbulong sa warts.
english: If you want to get rid of warts, it is best to consult a dermatologist because they have different treatments for warts.
