text: Isa na ka imposible nga handum ang impeachment batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: Impeachment against Vice President Sara Duterte is an impossible dream.

text: Ini suno kay Senate President Vicente “Tito” Sotto III kasunod sang desisyon sang Korte Suprema nga palig-unon pa ukon i-uphold ang nauna nga desisyon sini nga nagadeklarar nga unconstitutional ang impeachment sang Kamara batok sa bise-presidente.
english: Senate President Vicente “Tito” Sotto III said this follows the Supreme Court's decision to uphold its previous decision declaring the impeachment of the House of Representatives against the vice-president unconstitutional.

text: Sa statement ni Sotto, ginpahayag sini nga masubo ini nga adlaw para sa mga estudyante kag propesor sang Constitutional Law bangud sa ginhimo sang Supreme Court nga pag-amyendar “unconstitutionally” sa Konstitusyon.
english: In a statement, Sotto said it was a sad day for students and professors of Constitutional Law because of the Supreme Court's “unconstitutional” amendment to the Constitution.

text: Dinekada pa ang hulaton suno sa iya antes matadlong ini nga misinterpretation.
english: He said it will take decades before this misinterpretation is corrected.

text: “The Constitution had just been amended unconstitutionally through the Supreme Court’s overreach.
english: “The Constitution had just been amended unconstitutionally through the Supreme Court’s overreach.

text: It will take decades of retirements to correct this misinterpretation.
english: It will take decades of retirements to correct this misinterpretation.

text: When the law is clear, there is nothing to interpret, as any first-year law student knows,” kabahin sang statement ni Sotto.
english: When the law is clear, there is nothing to interpret, as any first-year law student knows,” Sotto said in a statement.

text: Pahayag pa sini, ang ruling sang Korte Suprema ang maathag nga pagsulod ukon pagpahilabot sa gahum sang legislative branch.
english: He said the Supreme Court's ruling is a clear interference in the powers of the legislative branch.

text: Sa amo nga desisyon suno sa iya, naghimo ang Supreme Court sang bag-o nga pagsulundan nga sundon sang Kongreso kun may impeachment.
english: In that decision, he said, the Supreme Court made a new rule for Congress to follow in the event of impeachment.

text: “The decision is a clear judicial legislation.
english: “The decision is a clear judicial legislation.

text: The SC, as written in their decision, admitted of introducing a rule for Congress to follow in the conduct of impeachment.
english: The SC, as written in their decision, admitted of introducing a rule for Congress to follow in the conduct of impeachment.

text: A clear encroachment on the power of the Legislative branch, as provided for by the Constitution,” suno sa Senate President.
english: A clear encroachment on the power of the Legislative branch, as provided for by the Constitution,” according to the Senate President.

text: “Impeachment is now an impossible dream,” dugang sini.
english: “Impeachment is now an impossible dream,” it added.

text: Kahapon, Enero 29, sang gin-anunsyo ni Supreme Court spokesperson Atty. Camille Ting nga nag-desisyon ang en banc sang may pinalidad nga ginabasura sini ang motion for reconsideration nga ginpasaka sang Kamara.
english: Yesterday, January 29, when Supreme Court spokesperson Atty. Camille Ting said the en banc decided with penalty that it dismisses the motion for reconsideration filed by the House.

text: Ang amo nga mosyon sang Kamara ang nagatuyo kuntani nga baliskaron ang nauna nga desisyon sang Korte Suprema nga nagdeklarar sang articles of impeachment batok kay Duterte bilang unconstitutional.
english: The House motion was aimed at overturning the Supreme Court's previous decision that declared the articles of impeachment against Duterte unconstitutional.

text: Matandaan nga ginpasaka sa Senado ang ikaapat nga impeachment complaint batok kay Duterte sadtong Pebrero 5, 2025.
english: The fourth impeachment complaint against Duterte was filed in the Senate on February 5, 2025.

text: Sa paglantaw sang Supreme Court, covered na ini sang one-year bar rule sandig sa Article XI, Section 3, Subsection 5 sang Constitution.
english: In the Supreme Court's view, it is covered by the one-year bar rule under Article XI, Section 3, Subsection 5 of the Constitution.

text: Suno naman kay Senator Imee Marcos nga kaalyado ni Duterte, ang desisyon sang Korte Suprema ang nagapakita sang kadalag-an sang rule of law kag pamatuod nga wala sang tawo nga labaw pa sa Konstitusyon.
english: Senator Imee Marcos, an ally of Duterte, said the Supreme Court's decision shows the victory of the rule of law and proof that no one is above the Constitution.

text: Apisar sini, sigurado man ang senadora nga may impeachment complaint na naman nga i-file batok sa vice president sa Pebrero 6.
english: However, the senator is also sure that an impeachment complaint will be filed against the vice president on February 6.

text: “This is a victory for the rule of law and a reminder that no matter how powerful are the people behind the impeachment of VP Sara, no one is above the Constitution,” suno sa presidential sister.
english: “This is a victory for the rule of law and a reminder that no matter how powerful are the people behind the impeachment of VP Sara, no one is above the Constitution,” said the presidential sister.

text: “But whilst there will be no more shortcuts, we are full[y] certain that another impeachment complaint will be filed after February 6,” dugang sini.
english: “But whilst there will be no more shortcuts, we are full[y] certain that another impeachment complaint will be filed after February 6,” it added.

text: Matandaan nga sang Disyembre 2024, tatlo ka impeachment complaints ang ginpasaka batok kay Duterte nga lunsay naangot sa iya kontrobersyal nga confidential funds.
english: It can be recalled that in December 2024, three impeachment complaints were filed against Duterte, all related to his controversial confidential funds.

text: Ang ikaapat nga complaint amo ang gin-endorso sang Kamara kag ginpasaka sa Senado.
english: The fourth complaint was endorsed by the House and filed in the Senate.

text: Sang Agusto 2025, nagboto naman ang kadam-an sang mga senador nga i-archive ang articles of impeachment kasunod sang nauna nga desisyon sang Supreme Court nga unconstitutional ini.#
english: In August 2025, a majority of senators voted to archive the articles of impeachment following the Supreme Court's earlier decision that they were unconstitutional.

text: Nagtakop sa draw, 3-3, ang hampang sang Philippine women’s team batok sa home team sang Uzbekistan sa 2025 Women’s Futsal Asian Cup Qualifiers.
english: The Philippine women's team's match against Uzbekistan's home team in the 2025 Women's Futsal Asian Cup Qualifiers ended in a draw, 3-3.

text: Gina-uyatan na subong sang world no.
english: The world no.

text: 59 nga Filipinas ang 1-1-0 win-draw-loss card sa Group C samtang ang pihak nga team naman nga pang-18 sa world rankings ang may record nga 0-1-0.
english: 59 Philippines have a 1-1-0 win-draw-loss card in Group C while the other team, which is 18th in the world rankings, has a record of 0-1-0.

text: Kuatro minutos pa lang sa pagsugod sang hampang, naka-skor na si Isabella Flanigan para sa Philippine team kag napasundan ni Katrina Guillou sa ika-16 nga minuto sang first half.
english: Four minutes into the game, Isabella Flanigan scored for the Philippine team and was followed by Katrina Guillou in the 16th minute of the first half.

text: Dos minutos na lang ang nabilin sa hampang sang napalagyuhan sang beterana nga si Lyudmila Karachik ang tatlo ka defenders kag nahatagan ang host country sang 3-2 nga lead.
english: With two minutes left in the game, veteran Lyudmila Karachik escaped three defenders to give the host country a 3-2 lead.

text: Apang wala diri nagpasugot ang Filipinas kag nagbalos paagi sa wala nga tiil ni Judy Connolly nga nakaluwas man sa defense sang Uzbekistan rason nga nag-draw sa 3-3 sang nagahingapos na ang oras.
english: However, the Philippines did not agree and responded with the left foot of Judy Connolly who also saved the defense of Uzbekistan to draw 3-3 at the end of the hour.

text: Matandaan nga sa una nga hampang sang Filipinas sang Sabado, ginlutos sini ang Kuwait, 4-1.
english: It can be recalled that in the Philippines' first match on Saturday, it defeated Kuwait, 4-1.

text: Buwas, atubangon sang team ang Turkmenistan nga una na nalubong sa 6-1 blowout batok sa Australia.
english: Tomorrow, the team will face Turkmenistan, which was buried earlier in a 6-1 blowout against Australia.

text: Kun may operasyon gani ang mga kawatan, preparado gid sila nga tabunan ang ila nawong agud nga indi madali nga makilala sang mga tawo sa palibot.
english: Even when thieves have an operation, they are ready to cover their faces so that they are not easily recognized by the people around them.

text: Amo man sini ang ginhimo sang isa ka armado nga lalaki sang nangawat ini sa New York; apang na-remalaso ini kag nakilala gihapon paagi lamang sa iya colorful nga underwear!
english: A gunman did the same thing when he robbed New York; but it was remade and still recognizable only by its colorful underwear!

text: Natabo ang pagpangawat sa baligyaan sang sigarilyo sa Queens County sang Septyembre sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: The cigarette shop robbery in Queens County occurred in September last year.

text: Suno sa mga dokumento nga ginpasa sa korte sang nagligad lang nga semana, tatlo ka naka-maskara nga lalaki ang nagguwa sa salakyan kag nagsulod sa shop.
english: According to documents filed in court just last week, three masked men exited the vehicle and entered the shop.

text: Duha sa ila ang nagtaya sang pusil sa empleyado kag sa mga kustomer, samtang ang isa naman ka lalaki ang nangamot sa pag-bukas sa cash register kun sa diin nakuha ang masobra P166,000 nga cash; P55,000 nga balor sang sigarilyo kag medicinal marijuana products, kag apat ka smartphones.
english: Two of them pointed guns at employees and customers, while another man tried to open the cash register where more than P166,000 in cash was recovered; P55,000 worth of cigarettes and medicinal marijuana products, and four smartphones.

text: Mabudlay makilala ang tatlo bangud sa ila ginasuksok nga hoodie kag maskara, apang klaro sa surveillance videos ang colorful kaayo nga briefs sang ikatatlo nga kawatan nga nagalabaw sa iya nga low-waist pants — makit-an nga may naka-imprinta nga puti nga letter R kag may yellow naman nga naka-imprinta nga 1990.
english: It is difficult to identify the three because of their hoodies and masks, but surveillance videos show the colorful briefs of the third robber overlapping his low-waist pants — with a white letter R printed on it and a yellow 1990 printed on it.

text:
via Brooklyn Eagle

Ginpalapta sang mga pulis ang video, tubtub nga may nag-tip sa ila kun sa diin naga-istar.
english:
via Brooklyn Eagle

Police circulated the video, until someone tipped them off where he lived.

text: Suno sa tipster, nakit-an sini ang social media account sang amo nga suspek, kag nakit-an sa isa sa mga laragway sini nga suksok niya ang amo nga itsura sang briefs.
english: According to the tipster, he found the suspect's social media account, and saw in one of his pictures that he was wearing the same briefs.

text: Nag-imbestigar ang otoridad tubtub nga nakit-an nga nagsanto ang identity sang amo nga lalaki sa video sang shop kag sa mga laragway sini sang nauna ini nga naaresto bangud sa daan nga kaso.
english: Authorities investigated until they found that the identity of the man matched the video of the shop and the pictures of him when he was previously arrested for an old case.

text: Gindakop siya sa iya balay sa Queens paagi sa gintingob nga pwersa sang New York Police Department-Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms joint task force.
english: He was arrested at his home in Queens by a combined force of the New York Police Department-Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms joint task force.

text: Sa subong, nagahulat ini sang iya schedule para sa arraignment sa federal court sa Brooklyn.
english: He is currently awaiting his schedule for arraignment in federal court in Brooklyn.

text: Nagapabilin naman nga at large ang duha pa ka kaupdanan sini nga spotted nga naghimo sang krimen.
english: Two other accomplices who were spotted committing the crime remain at large.

text: AUSTRALIA – Atensyon sa mga babayi nga mahilig magkaon sang fast food!
english: AUSTRALIA – Attention to women who like to eat fast food!

text: Nagaguwa sa pagtuon nga ang mga babayi nga masami nagakaon sang fast food ang mabudlayan nga makabusong sa sulod sang isa ka tuig.
english: The study shows that women who eat fast food frequently will find it difficult to conceive within a year.

text: Suno kay Dr. Claire Roberts, researcher sa University of Adelaide sa Australia, ang mga babayi nga indi mahilig magkaon sang prutas ang may risgo nga 8-12 percent nga mangin baog ukon indi makabusong.
english: According to Dr. Claire Roberts, researcher at the University of Adelaide in Australia, women who do not like to eat fruit have an 8-12 percent risk of infertility or failure to conceive.

text: Nagataas pa gid ang infertility sa 8-16 percent kun ang babayi ang masami nga nagakaon sang burgers, pizza, fries kag fried chicken bangud nga ang pagkaon sang unhealthy food ang nagapataas sang infertility.
english: Infertility increases to 8-16 percent if a woman often eats burgers, pizza, fries and fried chicken because eating unhealthy food increases infertility.

text: Ginkilala sang Billboard Music Awards ang 35-anyos nga American music superstar nga si Taylor Swift bilang All-Time Top Winner matapos nalab-ot ang 49 wins sa iya bug-os nga karera sa musika.
english: The Billboard Music Awards recognized 35-year-old American music superstar Taylor Swift as the All-Time Top Winner after reaching 49 wins throughout her music career.

text: Si Taylor na subong ang nagauyat sang pinakamataas nga record sa history sang BBMA kag ginasundan ni Drake nga may 39 wins.
english: Taylor now holds the highest record in BBMA history followed by Drake with 39 wins.

text: Sa awards ceremony subong nga tuig, may 10 ka bag-o nga trophies si Taylor lakip na ang Top Artist, Top Female Artist, Top Billboard 200 Artist, Top Hot 100 Artist, Hot 100 Songwriter, Top Streaming Songs Artist kag Top Billboard 200.
english: At this year’s awards ceremony, Taylor had 10 new trophies including Top Artist, Top Female Artist, Top Billboard 200 Artist, Top Hot 100 Artist, Hot 100 Songwriter, Top Streaming Songs Artist and Top Billboard 200.

text: Ini man ang ikaduha nga sunod-sunod nga tuig nga 10 ka awards ang iya nakuha halin sa BBMA.
english: This is also the second year in a row that she has won 10 awards from the BBMA.

text: Sang nagligad nga inadlaw lamang sang gintapos sang Grammy-winner ang iya “Eras Tour” sa Vancouver, Canada kag ginhatag man ang P11.4 billion bilang bonus sa mga tawo nga nagbulig sa iya tour sa nagligad nga duha ka tuig.
english: The Grammy-winner recently concluded his “Eras Tour” in Vancouver, Canada and also gave P11.4 billion as a bonus to people who helped him on his tour in the past two years.

text: “Everything that’s happened with the Eras Tour and ‘The Tortured Poets Department,’ I just have to say thank you.
english: “Everything that’s happened with the Eras Tour and ‘The Tortured Poets Department,’ I just have to say thank you.

text: It means the world to me that you guys have embraced the things I’ve made and the fact that you’ve cared so much about my music,” kabahin sang pre-recorded speech ni Taylor sa BBMA.
english: It means the world to me that you guys have embraced the things I’ve made and the fact that you’ve cared so much about my music,” was part of Taylor’s pre-recorded speech at the BBMA.

text: Marso 17, 2023 sang nagsugod ang iya tour sa Arizona, USA kag nakahapit sa 149 ka mga syudad lakip na sa Singapore kag sa Japan nga amo ang duha ka Asian stops.
english: His tour started on March 17, 2023 in Arizona, USA and has stopped in 149 cities including Singapore and Japan which are the two Asian stops.

text: Magapakasal na ang American singer-actress nga si Selena Gomez sa iya boyfriend nga si Benny Blanco.
english: American singer-actress Selena Gomez is getting married to her boyfriend Benny Blanco.

text: Gin-anunsyo sang 32-anyos nga entrepreneur ang iya engagement sa 36-anyos nga songwriter matapos una nga ginsapubliko ang ila relasyon sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: The 32-year-old entrepreneur announced her engagement to the 36-year-old songwriter after their relationship was first made public last year.

text: Lakip sa ginpakita ni Selena amo ang iya singsing kag ila sweet photos nga may caption “forever begins now”.
english: Selena showed off her ring and their sweet photos with the caption “forever begins now”.

text:
Sabat naman ni Blanco, “Hey wait… that’s my wife.”

Madasig naman nga nagkomento ang iya suod nga abyan nga si Taylor Swift: “Yes I will be the flower girl.”

Lakip man sa nagpanginbulahan amo sanday Cardi B, Gwyneth Paltrow, Jennifer Aniston, Suki Waterhouse, Lil Nas X kag iban pa.
english:
Blanco replied, “Hey wait… that’s my wife.”

Her close friend Taylor Swift was quick to comment: “Yes I will be the flower girl.”

Also congratulating were Cardi B, Gwyneth Paltrow, Jennifer Aniston, Suki Waterhouse, Lil Nas X and others.

text: Si Selena nga tumandok sang Texas, USA ang may yara sang 423-million followers sa Instagram kag ginakabig nga “most followed woman” sa amo nga social media app.
english: Selena, a native of Texas, USA, has 423-million followers on Instagram and is considered the “most followed woman” on the social media app.

text: Tag-iya man siya sang cosmetic brand nga Rare Beauty kag gin-anunsyo anay sang Septyembre nga nalakip na siya sa ‘youngest self-made billionaires in the United States’ nga may net worth nga $1.3 billion suno sa Bloomberg.
english: She is also the owner of the cosmetic brand Rare Beauty and announced in September that she was among the ‘youngest self-made billionaires in the United States’ with a net worth of $1.3 billion according to Bloomberg.

text: May yara siya anay sang high profile on-and-off relationship kay Bieber kag naka-date man ang singer nga si The Weeknd sang 2017.
english: She previously had a high profile on-and-off relationship with Bieber and also dated singer The Weeknd in 2017.

text: Si Blanco naman ang isa ka record producer nga naka-trabaho kaupod kanday Rihanna, Calvin Harris kag Justin Bieber.
english: Blanco is a record producer who has worked with Rihanna, Calvin Harris and Justin Bieber.

text: Antes ginsapubliko ang ila nga relasyon, naka-updanay na sila nga duha sa mga kanta nga I Can’t Get Enough sang 2019 kag Single Soon sang 2023.#
english: Before making their relationship public, the two have collaborated on the songs I Can't Get Enough in 2019 and Single Soon in 2023.#

text: Ginkwestyon ni Iloilo City Councilor Romel Duron ang Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) kag Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) kun paano nakakuha sang Fishpond Lease Agreement ang 60 ka ektarya nga Mangrove area sa bahin sang Brgy.
english: Iloilo City Councilor Romel Duron questioned the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) and Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) how the 60 hectares of mangrove area in Brgy.

text: Bitoon, Jaro Iloilo City.
english: Bitoon, Jaro Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Councilor Duron, iya ginpahayag nga natingala ang pila ka mga manugpangisda bangud nga gindumilian na ang mga ini sa pagsulod sa lugar sang tion nga personal ini nga nagpadulong sa amo nga area.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Councilor Duron said some fishermen were surprised because they were banned from entering the area when he personally visited the area.

text: Dugang pa sini nga nakapangalan sa Diego Agri Aqua and Land Ventures ang nasambit nga fishpond nga may lease agreement nga may petsa nga Pebrero 28, 2025 kag may numero nga 6351, kun sa diin sakop sini ang halos 35 ka ektarya sang lugar.
english: He added that the fishpond is registered with Diego Agri Aqua and Land Ventures with a lease agreement dated February 28, 2025 and number 6351, which covers nearly 35 hectares of land.

text: Napetsahan man nga Pebrero 28,2025 ang isa ka agreement nga may numbero nga FLA No.
english: Also dated February 28, 2025 is an agreement with number FLA No.

text: 3483-8 nga sakop ang 25 ka ektarya kag ginapanag-iyahan sang pareho lamang nga indibidwal.
english: 3483-8 covering 25 hectares and owned by the same individual.

text: Matandaan nga nagpatigayon sang imbestigasyon si Duron bangud sa alegasyon nga gin-hatagan sang pribado nga land titles ang halos 50 ka ektarya nga mangrove areas sa Iloilo Strait nga ginakabig nga protektado nga public land.
english: Duron conducted an investigation into allegations that private land titles were given to nearly 50 hectares of mangrove areas in the Iloilo Strait that are considered protected public land.

text: Sa karun, nagakabalaka si Duron sa halit nga posible nga matuga sini sa mga mangrove areas.
english: Duron is now concerned about the damage it could cause to mangrove areas.

text: Ginpasiguro man sini nga handa siya maghimo sang tikang agud mapangapinan ang kinamatarong sang mga pumuluyo kag ang dunang manggad sa nasambit nga lugar.
english: He also assured that he is ready to take steps to protect the rights of the people and the natural resources in the said area.

text: Nakaluwas ang isa ka former board member sang Maguindanao del Sur matapos ini nga gin-ambush sa Tacurong City, Sultan Kudarat.
english: A former board member of Maguindanao del Sur survived after he was ambushed in Tacurong City, Sultan Kudarat.

text: Base sa impormasyon, nagsakay ang 51-anyos nga si Datu Flank Mlok sa iya bullet-proof SUV nga Toyota Fortuner sa Barangay New Carmen sang ginpalukpan ini sang mga lalaki nga sakay sa motorsiklo.
english: According to reports, 51-year-old Datu Flank Mlok was riding in his bullet-proof SUV Toyota Fortuner in Barangay New Carmen when he was attacked by men on a motorcycle.

text: Nakabalos ang anay opisyal kag gintiro ang mga suspek kun sa diin, base sa nakakita, naigo sang bala ang isa sa mga nagtiro kay Mlok.
english: The former officer retaliated and shot the suspects where, according to witnesses, one of the shooters hit Mlok.

text: Nagapadayon pa ang imbestigasyon agud matumod ang mga tawo nga nagtuyo nga patyon ang anay opisyal.
english: Investigation is still ongoing to identify the people who tried to kill the former officer.

text: Nakaangkon sang injury ang Pinoy basketball star nga si Kevin Quiambao sa iya imbukada nga hampang sa Goyang Sono Skygunners sa idalom sang Korean Basketball League.
english: Pinoy basketball star Kevin Quiambao suffered an injury in his opening match against the Goyang Sono Skygunners under the Korean Basketball League.

text: Sais puntos lamang kag isa ka rebound ang nahimo ni KQ sa iya halos siyete minutos nga pag-upod sa game sang Goyang Sono antes ini nagguwa kag wala na nagbalik.
english: KQ managed just six points and one rebound in his nearly seven-minute stint in the Goyang Sono game before exiting and never returning.

text: Nalutos ang ila team, 84-57, batok sa Seoul SK Knights.
english: Their team lost, 84-57, to the Seoul SK Knights.

text: Natabo ang injury sang nagtuyo si Quiambao nga magpasulod sang tres apang natapakan sang iya tuo nga tiil ang iya kasumpong antes sila nagligid nga duha sa court.
english: The injury occurred when Quiambao tried to hit a three but his right foot stepped on his opponent before they both rolled on the court.

text: Bangud sa ila ika-lima nga sunod-sunod na nga kalutusan, nag-us-os pa sa 9-20 ang record sang Goyang.
english: Due to their fifth consecutive defeat, Goyang's record dropped to 9-20.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, nagsaka naman sa 22-6 ang record sang kasumpong nga Seoul nga may Pinoy import man nga si Juan Gomez De Liaño.
english: Meanwhile, the record of opponent Seoul, which also has Filipino import Juan Gomez De Liaño, rose to 22-6.

text: Nahibaluan nga former superstar sang De La Salle University si KQ, nangin two-time UAAP Most Valuable Player, kag kabahin sang ginpili ni Coach Tim Cone nga mangin parte sang Gilas Pilipinas.
english: KQ is a former superstar of De La Salle University, a two-time UAAP Most Valuable Player, and part of Coach Tim Cone's selection to be part of Gilas Pilipinas.

text: ILOILO CITY – Diri sa Pilipinas, naandan naton nga mga matahom nga bulak ukon flower-bearing small trees ang ginatanom sa mga center islands.
english: ILOILO CITY – Here in the Philippines, we are used to beautiful flowers or flower-bearing small trees are planted in the center islands.

text: Apang sa Japan, puno sang saging ang gintanum sang isa ka 50-anyos nga lalaki.
english: But in Japan, a 50-year-old man planted a banana tree.

text: Sa Kurume City sa Fukuoka Prefecture, ginmanduan ang wala ginhingadlan nga lalaki nga kuhaon ang tatlo ka puno sang saging nga iligal niya nga gintanom kag ginsagud sa center island sa isa ka busy city road sa sulod na sang duha ka tuig.
english: In Kurume City in Fukuoka Prefecture, an unnamed man was ordered to remove three banana trees that he illegally planted and maintained on the center island on a busy city road for the past two years.

text: Indi pa klaro kun ngaa nga ginpili sang lalaki nga magtanom sang saging sa public property kag sa kadamuon sang lugar, sa center island pa.
english: It is not clear why the man chose to plant bananas on public property and in the large area, even on the center island.

text: Ini ang naga-apekto na sa view sang mga motorista.
english: This is already affecting the view of motorists.

text: Wala na nabudlayan pa ang mga otoridad sa pagtumod sa lalaki bangud duha ka beses sa isa ka adlaw ang pagbunyag niya sa saging.
